tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i mngon rtogs dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i mngon par rtogs pa dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnas skabs bzhi yi sgrib pa bcom/ /thig le bzhi po mi 'gyur 'dzin/ /sku bzhi yi ge bzhi rang bzhin/ /bla ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde chen mchog tu mi 'gyur bas/ /bskyed pa'i sgrib bral phung po dang / /khams dang skye mched gang gi sku/ /yin pa'i dus 'khor de la 'dud/ /phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub ni/ /sgrub byed rdzogs pa'i rim pa la/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa sngon 'gro zhing / /de la dbang bskur sngon 'gror gsungs/ /de la sems can sngon 'gro zhing / /de la phyi yi 'jig rten dang / /de la'ang rdul phran 'dus pa ni/ /sngon du 'gro bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ /snod rten skal ldan sems can gang / /rgyud ni dbang gis smin pa yis/ /brtags pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yis/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom par bya/ /'di las bsod nams tshogs dang ni/ /'og min gnas kyi mthar thug pa'i/ /'jig rten pa yi dngos grub sgrub/ /de ni rgyud kyi dgos par gsungs/ /de las rtog sgom dang bral ba'i/ /mi 'gyur bde ba'i sgrub thabs kyis/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas myur 'grub pa/ /de ni dgos pa'i dgos par bshad/ /de ltar bden gnyis la brten pa'i/ /rim gnyis rdo rje can gyis bstan/ /de nas kun rdzob la brten pa'i/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa bshad par bya/ /'dir dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing / dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa'i sgrub pa po/ bla ma dang / sangs rgyas la gus shing / sems can la snying brtse bas gzhan gyi don byed pa la brtson pas/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i gnas lugs la mkhas pa'i shes rab dang ldan pas/

gnas spyir chos ldan gyi rgyal pos bskyangs shing / rgyal po dang skye bo phan tshun rtsod pa med pa/ khyad par zhi ba la sogs pa'i las la mtsho 'gram la sogs pa las dang rjes su mthun pa sems tshim par gyur pa'i gnas su/ dus 'khor gyi bris sku la sogs pa bzhugs su gsol/ mchod bstod dang maṇḍal la sogs pa bshams la/ 'jam pa'i stan la kha shar du phyogs pas 'dug ste mngon par rtogs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /'di la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum gyi/ dang po la kha lag dag pa'i cho ga sku gsung thugs ye shes sbyang ba/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i cho ga'o/ /dang po ni/ bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu khar bcug pa'am/ med na chang gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rdo rje drug ka'i sngags lan bdun brjod de/ mtheb srin gyis lce la bzhag cing oṃ hraḥsarb+ba asatra rā dza mā ra kle sha anta kā ra badzra tīkṣ+ṇa duḥkha tstshed ma ma ka raṃ baṃ sho dha a swāhā/ zhes brjod de/ phan tshun lag pa mnyes par bkrus par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥhaṃ kṣaḥ pra dzño pā ya ātma ka kā ya wākka/ tsitta dzñā na a dhi pa ti ma ma kā ya wākka tsitta dzñā na badzra mri ta swa bhā waṃ ku ru ku ru skandha dhā twā ya tā nī niḥ swā bhā waṃ swāhā/ zhes brjod pas gtsug tor gyi steng du waṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha bcu drug yongs su rdzogs par bsgom ste/ de'i 'od kyis gtsug tor nas rkang sen gyi bar rang gi lus sbrul gyi shun pa brjes pa ltar lan gsum dor nas/ rang lus zla ba'i kha dog can gyi dus kyi 'khor lo'i skur bsgom ste zhi rgyas la'o/ /dbang dgug la raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis shun pags dor nas kha dog dmar po'i sku dang / bsad bskrad la yaṃ las sgra gcan nag po las kha dog nag po dang / rengs rmongs la laṃ las dus me'i dkyil 'khor ser po las ser po dang /

slar gso ba la haṃ las nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ljang khu las ljang khu'i skur bsgom ste/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarb+ba dharm+māḥswa bhā wa shuddho haṃ/ zhes pas dag pa'i nga rgyal gzugs ste/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung nas mthe bong gi bar gyi rtsa ba'i tshigs lnga la/ a i ṛ u li/ bar tshigs la/ a e ar o al/ rtse mo'i tshigs la/ ha ya ra wa la te/ dbyangs thung ngu bco lnga las grub pa'i zla ba cha bco lnga yongs su rdzogs pa dang / g.yas kyi mthe bong nas mthe'u chung gi bar gyi rtse mo'i tshigs la/ lā wā rā yā ha/ bar tshigs la/ āl au ār ai ā/ rtsa ba'i tshigs la/ l̥̄ ū ṝ ī ā ste dbyangs ring po bco lnga las grub pa'i nyi ma dang / lag pa gnyis kha sbyar ba zla ba dang nyi ma'i dbus su hūm̐ sngon po bsams te/ zla nyi sgra gcan gyi sa bon de dag yongs su gyur pa las lag pa gnyis rdo rje rtse lnga par bsgoms la/ lag par sbyar ba'i mthe bong mthe'u chung so sor rtse sprad/ gung mo mnyam pa'i rgyab tu mdzub mo gnyis phyed 'khyog gi tshul du bzhag ming med 'og tu bskum pa lag mthil du son pa/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcings te des gtsug tor nas rkang sen gyi bar yan lag thams cad la reg cing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ kṣaḥka'u ya wākka tsitta dzñā na a dhi pa ti badzra kā ya ma ma kā ya wākka tsitta dzña na badzra kā ya swa bhā waṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas/ oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta badzra kā ya swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas rdo rje'i sku'i nga rgyal gzung ngo / /gnyis pa la gnyis las/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa ni/ rang gi thugs khar paṃ las padma dmar po'i dbus su a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa las 'od zer kha dog lnga spros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar rgyal ba sras bcas dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan drangs/

'od zer snying kha'i zla ba rdo rje la bsdus te/ stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /srid gsum skye dang 'jig pa med/ /shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes sogs kyis phyag byas te/ /rang gi snying kha'i zla ba'i steng du/ ming yig dang po las byung ba'i mchod yon bsang gtor gyi snod dang rdzas/ ka kha ga gha nga / ka kha ga gha ngā las rol mo gar ma ljang khu rnga pa ṭa ha dang gos bsnams pa/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ tsa tsha dza dzha nyā las dri phreng ma nag mo dung chos dang me tog sngon po'i phreng ba bsnams pa/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇā las spos mar me ma dmar mo spos snod dang mar me bsnams pa/ pa pha ba bha ma/ pa pha ba bha mā las bshos 'bras bu ma dkar mo bdud rtsi'i snod dang 'bras bu 'dzin pa/ ta tha da dha na/ ta tha da dha nā las sgeg bzhad ma ser mo dbu rgyan dang do shal 'dzin pa/ snya pa ṣa sha tha ka snya pa ṣa sha tha kā las glu 'dod ma sngon mo rdo rje dang padma 'dzin pa spros pas rang rang gi mchod rdzas dang / 'dod mas snyoms par 'jug pa'i bde bas mchod par bsam zhing / so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra i daṃ gṛhna gṛhna arghaṃ kaṃ me pu na ri yaṃ dang / de bzhin du arghaṃ kaṃ gi gnas su/ prokṣa ṇaṃ bcug pa dang / oṃ tsa tsha dza dzha nya badzra gandhe gandha artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ o tsa tsha dza dzha nyā badzra mā le mā la artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa badzra dhū pe dhū pa artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇā badzra pra dī pe pra dī pa artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ pa pha ba bha ma badzra a mri te nai wi dyai pū dzaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ pa pha ba bha mā badzra akṣa te akṣa ta pa la artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ta tha da dha na badzra lā sye wasatra ā bha ra ṇa pū dzaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ ta tha da dha nā badzra hā sya ghaṇḍa ā darṣa pū dzaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/

oṃ ka kha ga gha nga badzra bā dye bā dya pū dzaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ka kha ga gha ngā badzra nṛ tye nṛ tya pū dzaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ snya pa ṣa sha tha ka badzra gī te gī ta pū dzaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ snya pa ṣa sha ṭha kā badzra kā me sarb+ba buddha bo dhi satwā nāṃ kro dhā dī nāṃ badzra su ra taṃ pū dza ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas mchod nas/ thog med dus nas lus ngag yid kyis sdig pa rnam pa mang po bsags pa ni bshags par bgyi/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rnam mang dge ba gang byas pa/ de dag mtha' dag la ni sdig pa rnam bral byang chub spyod la rjes yi rang / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog la yang byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ 'gro ba nyon mongs nad kyis gdung ba bsal slad rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur cig /ces 'dir ni smon lam sems can don gyi slad du bdag bgyid do/ /rtsa ba gsum dang pha rol phyin bcu tshad med bsdu dngos la gnas mi dge bcu las ldog par bgyi/ sgrib pa lnga dang nyon mongs rnam bzhi zag pa bzhi po rnams spangs rnam par thar pa bsgom par bgyi/ zhes don dran bzhin pas brjod do/ /gnyis pa ye shes kyi tshogs ni/ dngos po med la bsgom pa med/ /sgom pa sgom pa nyid ma yin/ /de ltar dngos po dngos mi 'gyur/ /sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /zhes pas chos thams cad rgyu 'bras ngo bo gsum gyis stong pa'i mtshan nyid du bltas la/ /'khor ba'i phung po'i ngar 'dzin spang zhing / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phung po bzung ba'i phyir/ chus me nyams par byas/ me dang bral ba'i sa chu la thim/ chu rlung gis bskams/ rlung nam mkha' la thim ste/ sems kun gzhi'i rnam shes nam mkha'i khams rnam pa thams cad pa'i gzugs kyi rang bzhin du bsgoms la/

oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ oṃ a ni mitta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ oṃ a pra ṇi hi ta dzñā ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko haṃ/ oṃ a na bhi saṃ kas dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko haṃ/ zhes brjod nas khams gsum po la phra rab kyi chos nyid las 'das pa/ stong pa nyid kyi gzugs su bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang / las rgyal mchog dang / thig le'i rnal 'byor dang / phra mo'i rnal 'byor dang bzhi'i dang po la/ rten dang brten pa bskyed pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ nam mkha'i khams mtha' yas pa'i rang bzhin gyi chos 'byung gi nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po dbus su gzhu'i rnam pa thad kar dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi pa rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gsum pa dkris te nor bus mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gnyis pa pad mas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gcig pa rdo rjes mtshan pa/ so so'i steng 'og tu hūm̐ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje gnyis dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du maṃ las lhun po chen po rdo rje'i rang bzhin/ 'og gi rgyar dpag tshad stong phrag bcu drug dang / steng la dpag tshad stong phrag lnga bcu pa/ de'i dbus su kṣaṃ las pad ma ljang gu de'i phyed dang mnyam pa sum cha lte ba la yod pa'i steng du/ haṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lte ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du tsheg drag las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zla ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du thig le las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor sngon po nyi ma dang mnyam pa/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las haṃ kṣa ma la wa ra ya gi yi ger bsgom zhing / de yongs su gyur pa las/

'byung bzhi lhun po pad ma zla nyi sgra gcan dang bcas pa grub pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje'i sa gzhi la bhrūm̐ las sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor/ steng 'og tu brtsegs pa kun nas dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba can du bsam ste/ de yang sku'i dkyil 'khor phyi nas rim pa bzhin ser dkar dmar nag ljang ba'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i nang du de'i phyed kyi gsung gi dkyil 'khor rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i nang du de'i phyed kyi tshad kyi thugs kyi dkyil 'khor phyi nas dkar dmar nag pa'i rtsig pa'i gsum dang ldan pa/ gsum ka'ang gru bzhi sgo bzhi dang ldan pa/ ka ba ser po gnyis gnyis kyis btegs pa'i nor bu gser gyi rang bzhin gyi rta babs kyis brgyan pa/ rta babs so so la ka ba bzhi'i bar du lha mo gnas gsum gsum dang ldan pa'i brtsegs ma gsum pa'i 'og gi snam bu glang po che'i mgor seng ges mnan pa dang / bar dang steng gi snam bu sha la bhañdzi kas btegs pa/ snam bu so so'i rtse mor rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba dang / rnga yab/ me long / dril bu/ ba dan dkar po 'chang ba/ steng du harmi/ de'i steng du dbus su bum pa/ g.yas g.yon du rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba/ ka ba'i gsham nas myos pa bsrung bas bskor ba ste/ sku'i rta babs kyi rtseg 'og ma'i dbus su shar du hūm̐ las chos kyi 'khor lo nag po dang / g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo/ lhor āḥlas bum pa bzang po dmar po/ g.yas g.yon du dung dang padma/ byang du oṃ las rnga bo che dkar po/ g.yas g.yon du dbyug pa dang tho ba/ nub tu hoḥlas byang chub kyi shing ser po/ g.yas g.yon du mi'am ci pho mo dang bcas pa/ phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dkar pos bskor zhing / rtsig pa so so'i steng du rin po che'i snam bu dmar po/ rin po che'i 'ching ba rnam par bkra ba/ sgo khyud dang ka ba'i mtshams su rin po che dang /

zur bzhir sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ do shal dang do shal phyed pa dang me long dang rnga yab la sogs pas spras pa/ bya 'dabs las 'phyang ba'i ba gu li dkar po dang / de'i steng du kra ma shis rṣa padma'i 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyis bskor ba'i bar bar du rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa/ sku gsung gnyis kyi rtsig pa'i nang du rtsig pa la ma reg pa'i snam bu dkar po dang / thugs dkyil gyi snam bu phyogs kyi mdog can steng gi thog dang bcas pa/ thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi phyed kyi tshad kyi ye shes kyi 'khor lo la rdo rje phreng ba ljang khus bskor zhing / shar du ral gri nag po/ lhor rin po che dmar po/ byang du padma dkar po/ nub tu 'khor lo ser pos spras pa'i ka ba nag po bcu drug dang ldan pa/ de'i nang du de'i phyed kyi tshad kyi rdo rje'i phreng ba nag pos bskor bsams te/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ches/ /thugs gsung sku yi dkyil 'khor ro/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi rnams kyis ni/ /rdo rje'i thig ni bzhi po ste/ /dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi rnams kyis/ /kun nas gru bzhi pa nyid do/ /yan lag bcu gnyis 'gog pa yis/ /sgo ni bcu gnyis po rnams te/ /de bzhin sa ni bcu gnyis kyis/ /rta babs dag ni mdzes pa rnams/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad rnams kyis/ /phyogs brgyad du ni dur khrod rnams/ /stong nyid bcu drug ka ba rnams/ /khams rnams kyis kyang khang pa brtsegs/ /rnam thar brgyad kyis sgo khyud rnams/ /gzugs can yon tan brgyad rnams kyis/ /'gram rnams dang ni longs rnams nyid/ /thugs gsung sku yi dbye bas so/ /tshul khrims la sogs phung po lnga/ /kha dog lnga ni rnam sbyangs pa/ /theg pa gsum gyis ra ba gsum/ /dad pa'i dbang po sogs kyi lnga/ /dad sogs stobs rnams dag gi lnga/ /thugs gsung sku yi dkyil 'khor la'o/ /ting 'dzin dang ni gzungs rnams kyis/

/dkyil 'khor gsum la kha khyer te/ /pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs pa yis/ /rin chen snam bu rnam par bkra/ /ma 'dres chos ni bco brgyad kyis/ /do shal do shal phyed rnams nyid/ /dbang rnams kyis kyang ba gu li/ /dge bas kra ma shīngsha'o/ /stong nyid la sogs rnam thar gyis/ /dril bu'i sgra ni rdzogs pa ste/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pas rgyal mtshan gtams/ /spong bas me long rab tu 'bar/ /byang chub yan lag rnga yab g.yo/ /yan lag dgu yi phreng bas brgyan/ /bsdu ba bzhi po rnams kyis ni/ /zur du sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan/ /bden pa rin chen bzhi rnams kyis/ /sgo dang sgo khyud mtshams su spras/ /mngon shes lnga yis rtag tu ni/ /zlum skor chen po lnga yis bskor/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen byang chub pas/ /rdo rje'i phreng bas legs par bskor/ /bde ba gcig pu'i lcags ri yis/ de bzhin ye shes rdo rje 'bar/ /shes rab thabs kyi cha yis ni/ /zla ba nyi ma rtag tu shar/ /thugs gsung sku ni yang dag dag /chos kyi 'khor lo bum pa che/ /rnga bo che dang byang chub shing / /de bzhin yid bzhin nor bu sogs/ /'di dag dpal ldan dus 'khor gyi/ /dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyings dang ldan/ /zhes brjod cing don dran par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ saṃ nypaṃ ṣaṃ shaṃ ྈkaṃ las gtso bo'i padma ljang gu rtsa ba sdong bu 'dab ma ge sar lte ba dang bcas pa/ de bzhin du/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya las shar gyi le tshe'i dang / ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa las lho'i dang / pa pha ba bha ma las byang gi dang / ta tha da dha na las nub kyi dang / /tsā tshā dzā dzhā nyā las me'i dang / ṭā ṭhā ḍā ḍhā ṇā las srin po'i dang / pā phā bā bhā mā las dbang ldan gyi dang / tā thā dā dhā nā las rlung gi le tshe'i dang / tsaṃ tshaṃ dzaṃ dzhaṃ nyaṃ las shar sgo'i g.yas kyi dang / ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ las lho sgo'i g.yas kyi dang / paṃ phaṃ baṃ bhaṃ maṃ las byang sgo'i g.yas kyi dang /

taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ las nub sgo'i g.yas kyi dang / sa nypaṃ ṣa sha ྈkaḥlas shar sgo'i g.yon dang / ka kha ga gha nga las lho sgo'i g.yon dang / tsaḥtshaḥdzaḥdzhaḥnyaḥlas me'i snam bu'i dang / ṭaḥṭhaḥḍaḥḍhaḥṇaḥlas srin po'i snam bu'i dang / paḥphaḥbaḥbhaḥmaḥlas dbang ldan gyi dang / taḥthaḥdaḥdhaḥnaḥlas rlung gi snam bu'i dang / saḥkapaḥṣaḥshaḥྈkaḥlas byang sgo'i g.yon gyi dang / kā khā gā ghā ngā las nub sgo'i g.yon gyi dang / tsa tsha dza dzha nya las shar sgo'i dang / ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa las lho sgo'i dang / pa pha ba bha ma las byang sgo'i dang / ta tha da dha na las nub sgo'i padma dang / gzhan rnams su oṃ las padma/ dbus kyi lte bar oṃ aḥ a las zla nyi sgra gcan/ gzhan rnams su a las zla ba/ raṃ las nyi ma/ srog chags dang shing rta 'khor lo sogs rang rang gi ming yig dang po las byung ba/ phyi rol gyi mchod pa'i sa la padma bum pa sogs mchod rdzas du mas gang ba/ gzhal yas khang gi sa gzhi dang / steng logs thams cad kyi dbus ljang / shar nag lho dmar/ byang dkar/ nub ser/ phyi nas sa chu me rlung gi khor yug bzhis bskor ba'i sa'i dbang ldan du oṃ las zla ba/ srin por aḥlas nyi ma/ me rlung gi dbus su dur khrod chen po brgyad dang / nam mkha'i khor yug la rdo rje'i ra ba phyi rol 'od zer 'bar bas bskor bar bsam mo/ /gnyis pa brten pa bskyed pa la bzhi/ gtso bo mngon byang las bskyed/ /mngal nas dkyil 'khor spro/ 'gro la snying rje'i dbang bskur/ dag pa'i nga rgyal gzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du yar ngo'i cha bcu drug gi sa bon/ a i ri u li/ a e ar o al/ ha ya ra wa la aṃ rnams g.yon bskor mar ngo'i cha bcu drug gi sa bon/ lā wā rā yā hā/ āl au ār ai ā/ l̥̄ ū ṝ ī ā aḥrnams g.yas skor/ mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo yongs su gyur pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyangs so gnyis kyis mtshan pa me long lha bu'i ye shes rnam snang gi ngo bo/

de'i 'og tu/ lla wwa yya ḍḍa ḍhḍa/ lla wwa rar yya haha ssa nypa nypa ṣṣa shsha ྈka ྈka/ tta thatha dda dhadha ṇṇa/ ppa phapha bba bhabha mma/ ṭṭa ṭhaṭha ḍḍa ḍhḍa ṇṇa/ tstsa tshtsha dzdza dzhdza nynya/ kka khkha gga ghga ngnga/ rnams g.yas skor/ nga gha ga kha ka nya dzha dza tsha tsa/ ṇa ḍha ḍa ṭha ṭa/ ma bha ba pha pa/ na dha da tha ta/ ྈka sha ṣa nypa sa/ ha ya ra wa la/ ḍha ḍa ya wa la rnams g.yon skor/ dpe byad bzang po/ brgyad cu'i ngo bo yongs su gyur pa'i nyi ma/ kā lis mtshan pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rin 'byung gi ngo bo/ zla ba'i dbus su hūm̐ yig zla ba'i mtshan ma lta bu sor rtog ye shes snang mtha'i ngo bo/ zla nyi sa bon rnams g.yon skor/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo yongs su gyur pa'i nyi ma/ kā lis mtshan pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rin 'byung gi ngo bo/ zla ba'i dbus su hūm̐ yig zla ba'i mtshan ma lta bu sor rtog ye shes snang mtha'i ngo bo/ zla nyi sa bon rnams gcig tu 'dres pa srog rlung gi sa bon hi yig dang ldan pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes don grub kyi ngo bo'o/ /de yongs su gyur pa las rnam shes kyi sa bon haṃ yig tu grub pa chos dbyings ye shes mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo'o/ /de las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo dri ma med pa'i 'od zer rnam pa lnga 'pho ba/ sku lus byin sngon po/ mgrin pa gsum gyi dbus sngo/ g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar ba/ rtsa zhal nag po drag cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas zhal dmar po rjes su chags pa'i nyams can/ rgyab zhal ser po ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa/ g.yon zhal dkar po rab tu zhi ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ ral pa'i cod pan la sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / rdo rje sems dpa' gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ rdo rje nor bu dang / rdo rje rna rgyan dang / rdo rje mgul rgyan dang / rdo rje gdu bu dang / rdo rje ska rags dang / rdo rje rkang gdub dang /

rdo rje dar dpyangs dang / rdo rje phreng ba dang / stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ g.yas g.yon gyi phrag pa mdun sngo/ bar ma dmar/ rgyab ma dkar ba'i phrag pa drug dpung pa bcu gnyis/ phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i mdun ma bzhi nag bar ma bzhi dmar/ rgyab ma bzhi dkar ba'i mthe bong ser/ mdzub mo dkar/ gung mo dmar/ ming med nag mthe chung ljang / sor tshogs kyi phreng ba rtsa ba nag bar pa dmar/ rtse mo dkar/ rdo rje sor gdub kyis spras pa las 'od 'phro ba/ g.yas kyi phyag nag po bzhir rdo rje/ ral gri/ rtse gsum/ gri gug dmar po bzhir/ mda' gsum/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma ru/ tho ba/ dkar po bzhir 'khor lo/ mdung / dbyug pa/ dgra sta/ g.yon gyi nag po bzhir rdo rje dril bu/ phub/ kha ṭwāṃ ga rnam par rgyas pa/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ dmar po bzhir gzhu/ rdo rje zhags pa/ rin chen/ pad dkar/ dkar po bzhir dung / me long / rdo rje lcags sgrog tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ zla nyi sgra gcan gyi steng du shin tu rol pa'i g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i g.yas dmar brkyang bas 'dod lha dmar po gdong gcig pa lag pa dang po gnyis kyis me tog gi mda' lnga/ gzhu/ 'og ma gnyis zhags pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa dang / g.yon dkar po cung zad bskum pas drag po dkar po/ gdong gcig mig gsum pa/ g.yas gnyis rtse gsum/ ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa brdzis/ bdud dang drag po'i lha mo dga' ma dang u mas zhabs kyi mthil 'dzin cing gdong dman par byed bzhin pa/ de la mdun nas 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum gser gyi mdog can/ g.yas skor gyis ser dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal bzhi/ re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa phyag brgyad kyi g.yas na gri gug lcags kyu dang / sgra bcas ḍā ma ru/ bgrang phreng / g.yon na thod pa/ zhags pa/ pad dkar 'dab brgya/ rin chen bsnams pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can/

phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bcom ldan 'das dang snyoms par zhugs pa/ shar gyi 'dab ma la/ nag mo 'bar ma nag mo nag dmar/ ser/ dkar ba'i zhal bzhi ma/ g.yas spos/ tsan dan/ gur kum/ ga pur dang gla rtsi sbyar ba'i snod/ g.yon dril bu/ padma/ yongs 'du'i me tog me tog sna tshogs pa'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ lhor dmar mo 'bar ma dmar mo dmar ser dkar sngo ba'i zhal can/ g.yas mar me/ do shal/ cod pan/ gdu bu/ g.yon gos/ ska rags/ sna rgyan/ rkang gdub 'dzin pa/ byang du dkar mo 'bar ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ser ba'i zhal can/ g.yas 'o ma/ chu/ mchog gi sman/ chang gi snod/ g.yon bdud rtsi/ grub pa'i ro/ bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu/ zan gyi snod 'dzin pa/ nub tu ser mo 'bar ma ser mo ser dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal can/ g.yas dung / gling bu/ nor bu/ ḍā ma ru/ g.yon pi wang / rnga/ sgra sgrogs pa'i mkhar ba/ zangs dung 'dzin pa mer du ba ma nag mo 'bar ma lta bu/ phyag na rnga yab nag po brgyad/ bden bral du smig rgyu ma dmar mo 'bar ma lta bu/ rnga yab dmar po brgyad/ dbang ldan du mkha' snang ma dkar mo 'bar ma lta bu/ rnga yab dkar po brgyad 'dzin pa/ rlung du mar me ma ser mo 'bar ma lta bu/ rnga yab ser po brgyad 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can/ mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ zur bzhi'i dbang ldan du chos kyi dung dkar po/ bden bral du chos kyi gaṇḍī dmar po/ mer nor bu nag po/ rlung du dpag bsam gyi shing ser po bsam mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'dod chags chen pos 'dul bar bya ba'i sems can gyi 'jig rten dang po'i sangs rgyas bstan par bya ba'i snod du mngon par gzigs nas/ yum dang sbyar bas shin du dga' ba'i sgras rgyal ba lnga/ yum lnga/ sems dpa' sems ma rnams spyan drangs pa rang lus la zhugs/ slar rang lus las spros yum gyi sku la zhugs pa mkha' nang nas spros/

phung khams skye mched dang bcas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam pa rnams rang lus la zhugs te/ khu ba'i rang bzhin du zhu ba rnams yum gyi pad ma'i nang du rang gi rdo rje nas spros pa rang rang gi sa bon dang / de dag yongs su gyur pa las/ lha dang lha mo'i tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor rten gdan/ brten pa lha'i mtshan nyid mi bskyod pa rigs kyi bdag por gyur pa'i gtso bo hūm̐ dang rdo rje las bskyed pa dang / de dang dus mnyam du/ phreṃ dang gri gug las sna tshogs yum/ a dang spos snod las nag mo 'bar ma/ aḥdang mar me las dmar mo 'bar ma/ aṃ dang lha bshos las dkar mo 'bar ma/ ā dang dung las ser mo 'bar ma/ ha dang rnga yab nag po las du ba ma/ haḥdang rnga yab dmar po las smig rgyu ma/ haṃ dang rnga yab dkar po las mkha' snang ma/ hā dang rnga yab ser po las mar me ma/ oṃ las dung / āḥlas gaṇḍī/ hūm̐ las nor bu/ hoḥlas dpag bsam gyi shing rnams bskyed/ mngal nas spros/ gtso bo dang yum rnams dang mtshan ma so so la gzhug go /de bzhin du/ i dang ral gri las don grub nag po/ lī dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i spyan ma ser mos 'khyud pa spros shar gyi le tshor 'khod/ ṛ dang rin po che las rin 'byung dmar po/ u dang padma las skyes pa'i mā ma kī dkar mos 'khyud pa spros/ lhor ū dang padma las snang mtha' dkar po/ ṝ dang rin po che las skyes pa'i gos dkar mo dmar mos 'khyud pa spros/ byang du l̥ dang 'khor lo las rnam snang ser po/ ā+-i dang ral gri las skyes pa'i sgrol ma nag mos 'khyud pa spros nub tu 'khod/ de thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa/ pad dkar dang nyi mar rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa la/ yum rnams padma'i gdan gyis 'khyud pa/ bde gshegs rnams ral pa'i cod pan can no/ /ī dang ral gri las skyes pa'i sgrol ma nag mo/ l̥ dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i rnam snang ser pos 'khyud pa spros/

mer ṝ dang rin po che las gos dkar mo dmar mo/ u dang padma las skyes pa'i snang mtha' dkar pos 'khyud pa spros/ srin por u dang padma las mā ma kī dkar mo/ ṛ dang rin po che las skyes pa'i rin 'byung dmar pos 'khyud pa spros/ dbang ldan du l̥̄ dang 'khor lo las spyan ma ser mo/ i dang ral gri las skyes pa'i don grub nag pos 'khyud pa spros/ rlung du 'khod de de rnams pad dmar dang zla bar padma'i gdan gyis bzhugs pa la/ yab rnams rdo rje'i gdan gyis 'khyud pa'o/ /bde gshegs bzhi'i g.yon g.yas kyi le tsher hi hī las rkang dag pa'i bum pa gnyis spros/ shar du hṛ hṛ las khrag dag pa'i bum pa gnyis spros/ lhor hu hū las dri chu dag pa'i bum pa gnyis spros/ byang du hl̥ hl̥ las dri chen dag pa'i bum pa gnyis spros/ nub tu haṃ hāḥlas khu ba dang rdul dag pa'i bum pa gnyis spros/ steng 'og tu 'khod de/ thams cad kyang padma'i gdan la gnas shing padmas brgyan pa'o/ /yaṃ dang ral gri las shin tu stobs nag po/ lāḥdang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i rengs byed ma ser mos 'khyud pa spros/ shar sgor pad dmar dang zla bar/ raṃ dang rin po che las rmugs byed dmar po waḥdang padma las skyes pa'i khengs byed ma dkar mos 'khyud pa spros/ lho sgor pad dkar dang nyi mar/ waṃ dang padma las khengs byed dkar po rāḥdang rin po che las skyes pa'i rmugs byed ma dmar mos 'khyud pa spos/ byang sgor pad dmar dang zla bar/ lam dang 'khor lo las rengs byed ser po yāḥdang ral gri las skyes pa'i rab brtson ma nag mos 'khyud pa spros/ nub sgor pad dkar dang nyi mar 'khod de/ khro bo rnams g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa la/ khro mo rnams g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis 'khyud pa'o/ /e dang ral gri las mkha' snying nag po/ āl dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i dri rdo rje ma ser mos 'khyud pa spros/

nang nas blta ba'i shar sgo'i g.yas su pad dkar dang nyi mar 'khod/ ar dang rin po che las sa snying dmar po au dang padma las skyes pa'i gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mos 'khyud pa spros/ lho sgo'i g.yas su/ o dang padma las 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar po/ ār dang rin po che las skyes pa'i ro rdo rje ma dmar mos 'khyud pa spros/ byang sgo'i g.yas su/ al dang 'khor lo las sgrib sel ser po/ ai dang ral gri las skyes pa'i reg bya rdo rje ma nag mos 'khyud pa spros/ nub sgo'i g.yas su/ a dang rdo rje las phyag rdor ljang gu aḥdang rdo rje las skyes pa'i sgra rdo rje ma sngon mos 'khyud pa spros lho sgo'i g.yon du/ aṃ dang rdo rje las kun bzang sngon po/ ā dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i chos dbyings rdo rje ma ljang gus 'khyud pa spros/ shar sgo'i g.yon du pad dkar dang nyi mar 'khod/ yab rnams rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa la/ yum rnams pad ma'i 'dug stangs kyis 'khyud pa'o/ /yai dang ral gri las skyes pa'i reg bya rdo rje ma nag mo/ al dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i sgrib sel ser pos 'khyud pa spros/ mer ār dang rin po che las ro rdo rje ma dmar mo/ o dang padma las skyes pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar pos 'khyud pa spros/ srin por/ au dang padma las gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo/ ar dang rin po che las skyes pa'i sa snying dmar pos 'khyud pa spros/ dbang ldan du/ āl dang 'khor lo las dri rdo rje ma ser mo/ e dang ral gri las skyes pa'i nam snying nag pos 'khyud pa spros/ rlung du/ aḥdang rdo rje las sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo/ a dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i phyag rdor ljang gus 'khyud pa spros/ byang sgo'i g.yon du/ ā dang rdo rje las chos dbyings rdo rje ma ljang gu aṃ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i kun bzang sngon pas 'khyud pa spros/

nub sgo'i g.yon du 'khod/ thams cad kyang pad dmar dang zla bar gnas pa/ yum rnams padma'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa la/ yab rnams rdo rje'i gdan gyis 'khyud pa ste/ nag po rnams nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas ral gri/ gri gug rtse gsum/ g.yon phub/ thod pa/ kha ṭwāṃ ga dkar po/ dmar po rnams dmar dkar nag pa'i zhal can/ g.yas me'i mda'/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ sgra bcas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gzhu/ rdo rje zhags pa/ rin po che cha dgu pa/ dkar po rnams dkar nag dmar ba'i ra zhal can/ g.yas tho ba/ mdung / rtse gsum pa/ g.yon/ pad dkar 'dab brgyad/ me long / bgrang phreng / ser po rnams ser dkar nag pa'i zhal can/ g.yas 'khor lo/ dbyug pa/ rdo rje gdengs pa/ g.yon dung / lcags sgrog sgra bcas dril bu/ ljang gu rnams ljang dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ g.yas rdo rje/ gri gug dgra satwa/ g.yon dril bu/ thod pa/ tshangs mgo sngon po rnams sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal can phyag mtshan snga ma lta bu ste/ 'on kyang sgrol ma'i kha ṭwaṃ ga dang / kun bzang gi tshangs mgo'i gnas su utpal yang rung ngo / /gsung gi snam bu la de nas ha dang gri gug las tsa rtsi ka nag mo phyag bzhi g.yas gri gug rtse gsum/ g.yon thod pa/ kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa la l̥ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i dbang po ser pos 'khyud pa dang / h-i ya yi yri hī yu yal̥̄ yaṃ dang gri gug rnams las skyes pa'i 'jigs ma/ drag mo/ dus kyi mche ba ma/ me 'bar gdong ma/ rlung shugs ma/ rab gtum ma/ drag ma'i ma/ sna chen ma rnams spros/ gsung gi snam bu'i shar du yi dwags dmar po'i steng gi padma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la mdun nas g.yas skor gyi rim bzhin 'khod/ kṣa dang 'khor lo las khyab 'jug ma nag mo g.yas 'khor lo/ be con/ g.yon pad ma/ dung 'dzin pa la/ l̥̄ dang khab las skyes pa'i tshangs pa ser pos 'khyud pa dang / kṣi yā yī yṛ kṣī yū yal̥̄ yaḥ dang 'khor lo rnams las skyes pa'i g.yung mo/

sgyu ma/ grags ma/ dpal mo/ rnam par rgyal ma/ dpal ldan rgyal ma/ dpal ldan rgyal byed ma/ dpal ldan 'khor lo can ma rnams spros/ mer nam mkha' lding gi steng gi pad ma'i lte ba dang 'dab mar g.yas skor gyis rim bzhin 'khod/ haḥdang dbyug pa las phag mo dmar mo g.yas dbyug pa/ ral gri/ g.yon lcags sgrog phub 'dzin pa la/ u dang rtse gsum las skyes pa'i drag po dkar pos 'khyud pa dang / hṛ ra ṛ raṛ hṛ ru rl̥ raṃ dang dbyug pa rnams las skyes pa'i keng rus ma/ dus mtshan ma/ rab khros gdong ma/ dus lce ma/ gtsigs ma/ nag mo 'jigs rung ma/ ū dang dgra sta las skyes pa'i tshogs bdag dkar pos 'khyud pa dang / kṣ+r-i rā ṝ raṝ rarū kṣṝ rarū rl̥̄/ dang mdung thung rnams las skyes pa'i padma/ lus med ma/ gzhon nu ma/ ri dwags bdag pos 'gro ma/ rin chen phreng ba ma/ mig bzang ma/ rul ma/ bzang mo rnams spros/ srin por rma bya'i steng gi padma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma la g.yas skor gyis rim bzhin 'khod/ haṃ dang rtse gsum las drag mo dkar mo g.yas rtse gsum/ ḍā ma ru/ g.yon kha ṭwāṃ ga sbrul 'dzin pa la/ ri dang dbyug pa las skyes pa'i gshin rje dmar pos 'khyud pa dang / hu wa wi wṛ hū wu wal̥̄ waṃ dang rtse gsum rnams las skyes pa'i gau ri ma/ gaṃ gā ma/ rtag ma/ myur ma/ to ta la/ mtshon byed ma/ dmar ser ma/ nag mo rnams spros byang du khyu mchog gi steng gi padma'i lte ba dang 'dab mar g.yas skor gyis rim bzhin 'khod/ kṣaṃ dang padma las dpal chen mo dkar mo g.yas padma/ bgrang phreng / g.yon padma/ rin chen 'dzin pa la/ rī dang mdung las skyes pa'i gdong drug dmar pos 'khyud pa/ kṣu wā wī wṛ kṣu wū wal̥̄ waḥdang padma rnams las skyes pa'i dpal ldan dkar mo/ zla ba'i ri mo/ ri bong 'dzin ma'i gdong ma/ ngang pa'i mdog ma/ 'dzin ma/ pad ma'i dbang mo/ skar mig ma dri med ri bong 'dzin ma rnams spros/

dbang ldan du seng ge'i steng gi pad ma'i lte ba dang 'dab mar g.yas skor gyis rim bzhin 'khod/ ha dang rdo rje las dbang mo ser mo g.yas rdo rje/ mda'/ g.yon dril bu/ gzhu 'dzin pa la i dang ral gri las skyes pa'i bden bral nag po'i 'khyud pa dang / hl̥ la l̥ laṛ ll̥ lu ll̥ laṃ dang rdo rje rnams las skyes pa'i rdo rje 'od ma rdo rje lus ma/ gser ldan ma/ urba sī/ bkra ba'i ri mo ma/ rambha/ zug rngu med ma/ shin tu sgrol ma rnams spros/ nub tu glang po che'i steng gi padma'i lte ba dang 'dab mar rim bzhin 'khod/ kṣā dang snod dam spar bu las tshangs ma ser mo g.yas padma/ tshangs pa'i dbyug pa/ g.yon spyi blugs snod dam spar bu 'dzin pa la ī dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i khyab 'jug nag pos 'khyud pa dang / kṣl̥̄ lā l̥̄ laṛ kṣl̥ lū ll̥̄ laḥdang / snod rnams las skyes pa'i sā bi tri/ pad ma'i mig chu skyes can ma/ blo ma/ ngag gi dbang phyug ma/ gā ya tri ma/ glog ma/ dran ma rnams spros/ rlung du ngang pa'i steng gi padma'i lte ba dang 'dab mar g.yas bskor gyis rim bzhin 'khod/ de dag la gdong drug dang / gzhon nu ma ni gdong drug dang / tshangs pa tshangs ma ni gdong bzhi ma/ gtso mo rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la zhal phyogs pas sa ga'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa la/ yab rnams 'og nas 'byung ba'i phyag mtshan 'dzin pas sa ga'i stabs kyis 'khyud pa/ 'dab ma'i lha mo rnams rang rang gi gtso mo'i zhal mdog phyag mtshan 'dra bas gtso mo la zhal phyogs te/ sa ga'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /de nas sku'i snam bu la/ tsam dang ral gri las srin po nag po g.yas ral gri/ gri gug g.yon phub/ thod pa 'dzin pa la dzir dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i srin mo ser mo dbang mo lta bus 'khyud pa dang / nya nyi nyṛ nyu dang nyli nyaṃ/ dzha dzhi dzhṛ dzhu dzhla dzhaṃ dang / dza dzi dzu dzal dzaṃ/

tsha tshi tshri tshu tshl̥ tshaṃ/ tsa tsi tsri tsu tsla dang / ral gri rnams las skyes pa'i nya rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i nyer brgyad dang bcas nag pa'i zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams spros/ nang nas blta ba'i shar sgo'i g.yas kyi yi dwags dmar po'i steng gi padma dmar po zlum skor dang po la 'dab ma bzhi/ bar pa la brgyad/ phyi ma la bcu drug ste 'dab ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang ldan pa'i lte ba dang 'dab mar rim bzhin 'khod/ nyaḥdang dpag bsam gyi shing las rlung lha nag po g.yas dpag bsam gyi shing dang yongs 'du'i me tog g.yon ind+ra nī la dang utpal sngon po 'dzin pa la/ dzri dang be con las skyes pa'i rab gtum ma ser mo nor sbyin lta bus 'khyud pa dang / tsā tsī tsri tsū dang tslī tsaḥtshā tshī tshṝ tshū tshl̥ tshaḥdang / dzā dzī dzū dzal̥ dzaḥdzhā dzhī dzhṛ dzhu dzhl̥ dzhāḥ nyā nyī nyṛ nyū nyl̥ dang dpag bsam shing rnams las skyes pa'i tsā rdo rje ma la sogs pa sa ga'i zla ba'i chos kyi lha mo rnams spros/ mer ri dwags kyi steng gi padma dkar po'i lte ba dang 'dab mar rim bzhin 'khod/ ṭaṃ dang shakti las me lha dmar po g.yas shakti dbyug pa/ g.yon padma spyi blugs 'dzin pa la/ ḍṛ dang zhags pa las skyes pa'i chu lha mo dkar mo chu lha lta bus 'khyud pa dang / ṇa ṇi nṛ ṇu dang ṇal̥ ṇaṃ ḍha ḍhṛ ḍh-i ḍhra ḍhaṃ dang / ḍa ḍi ḍu ḍh-i ḍhaṃ/ ṭha ṭhi ṭhṛ ṭhu thal̥ thaṃ/ ṭa ṭi ṭaṛ ṭu ṭal̥ dang / shakti rnams las skyes pa'i ṇa rdo rje ma la sogs pa snron gyi zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams spros/ lho sgo'i g.yas kyi lug gi steng gi padma dmar po'i lte ba dang 'dab mar rim bzhin 'khod/ ṇaḥdang mdung las gdong drug dmar po gdong drug pa g.yas shakti mdung / g.yon rin po che long 'dzin pa la ḍṛ dang padma las skyes pa'i dpal chen mo dkar mos 'khyud pa dang / ṭā ṭī ṭaṛ ṭū dang / ṭal̥̄ ṭaḥṭhā ṭhī ṭhā+-i ṭhā ṭhū ṭhal̥̄ ṭhaḥdang /

ḍā ḍī ḍū ḍal̥̄ ḍaḥḍhā ḍhī ḍhṛ ḍhū ḍhā+-i ḍhaḥṇḍa ṇiā ṇa ṛṇū ṇal̥̄ dang / mdung rnams las skyes pa'i ṭā rdo rje ma la sogs pa chu stod kyi zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams spros/ srin por rma bya'i steng gi padma dkar po'i lte ba dang 'dab mar rim bzhin 'khod/ paṃ dang zhags pa las chu lha dkar po/ g.yas zhags pa rin chen/ g.yon sbrul zhags chu shel 'dzin pa la/ bṛ dang shakti las skyes pa'i phag mo dmar mo me lha lta bus 'khyud pa dang / ma mi mṛ mū dang ml̥ maṃ/ bha bhi bhṛ bhu bhal̥ bhaṃ dang / ba bi bṛ bu bl̥ baṃ/ pha phi phṛ phu phal̥ phaṃ/ pa pi pṛ pu pl̥ dang / zhags pa rnams las skyes pa'i ma rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i gro bzhin gyi zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams spros/ byang sgo'i g.yas su chu srin gyi steng gi pad ma dmar po'i lte ba dang 'dab mar rim bzhin 'khod/ maḥdang dgra sta las tshogs bdag dkar po g.yas dgra sta/ rdo rje/ g.yon zhags pa rin chen 'dzin pa la/ bṛ dang mdung thung las skyes pa'i gzhon nu ma dmar mos 'khyud pa dang / pā pī pri pū dang pl̥̄ paḥphā phā+-i phṛ phū phal̥ phaḥdang / bā bī bū bl̥̄ baḥ bhā bhā+-i bhṛ bhū bhal̥ bha dang / mā mī mṛ mū ml̥̄ maḥdang / dgra sta rnams las skyes pa'i pā rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i khrums stod kyi zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams spros/ dbang ldan du byi ba'i steng gi padma dkar po'i lte ba dang 'dab mar rim bzhin 'khod/ taṃ dang rdo rje las dbang po ser po g.yas rdo rje/ me'i mda'/ g.yon dril bu gzhu 'dzin pa la/ ngaṛ dang gri gug las skyes pa'i rlung lha mo nag mo tsartsi ka lta bus 'khyud pa dang / na ni nṛ nu dang nal̥ naṃ/ dha dhi dhṛ dhu dahl̥ dhaṃ dang / da dhi du dal̥ daṃ/ tha thi thṛ thu thal̥ thaṃ/ ta ti tṛ tu tal̥ dang / rdo rje rnams las skyes pa'i na rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i tha skar zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams spros/

nub sgo'i g.yas su glang po che'i steng gi padma dmar po'i lte ba dang 'dab mar rim bzhin 'khod/ naḥdang khab las tshangs pa ser po zhal bzhi pa g.yas khab bgrang phreng / g.yon padma dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa la/ ngaṛ dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i glog ma nag mo khyab 'jug ma lta bus 'khyud pa dang / tā tī tṛ tū dang tal̥ taḥ thā thī thṝ thū thal̥̄ thāḥdang / dā dī dū dal̥̄ diḥ dhā dhī dhṛ dhū dhal̥̄ dhaḥ nā nī nṛ nū nal̥ dang / khab rnams las skyes pa'i tā rdo rje ma la sogs pa smin drug gi zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams spros/ rlung du ngang pa'i steng du pad ma dkar po'i lte ba dang 'dab mar rim bzhin 'khod/ saṃ dang rtse gsum las drag po sngon po g.yas rtse gsum mda'/ g.yon sbrul dang bcas pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga gzhu 'dzin pa la/ ṣaṛ dang dbyug pa las skyes pa'i ri sras ma ljang gu phag mo lta bus 'khyud pa dang / ྈka ྈki ྈkṛ ྈku dang ྈkl̥ ྈkaṃ/ sha shi shṛ shu shl̥ shaṃ dang / ṣa ṣi ṣu shl̥ ṣaṃ/ nypa nypi nypaṛ nypu nylaṃ nypaṃ/ sa si sṛ su sl̥ dang / rtse gsum rnams las skyes pa'i rdo ma la sogs pa mgo'i zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams spros/ byang sgo'i g.yon du khyu mchog gi steng gi padma dmar po'i lte ba dang 'dab mar rim bzhin 'khod/ ྈkaḥdang be con las nor sbyin sngon po g.yas nor bu/ be con/ g.yon ne'u le padma 'dzin pa la/ ṣaṛ dang dbyug pa las skyes pa'i nor dbang mo ljang gu gshin rje lta bus 'khyud pa dang / sā sī sṛ sū dang sl̥ saḥ nypā nypī nypaṛ nypū nypal̥̄ nypāḥdang / ṣā ṣī ṣū ṣal̥̄ ṣaḥ shā shī shṝ shū shl̥̄ shaḥ ྈkā ྈkī ྈkṛ ྈkūྈkl̥̄ dang be con rnams las skyes pa'i sa rdo rje ma la sogs pa rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams spros/ nub sgo'i g.yon du glang po che'i steng gi padma dmar po'i lte ba dang 'dab mar rim bzhin 'khod/ kaṃ dang 'khor lo las khyab 'jug ljang gu

g.yas 'khor lo/ dbyug to/ g.yon padma skye ba lnga pa'i dung 'dzin pa la/ gari dang snod las skyes pa'i dpal mo sngon mo tshangs ma lta bus 'khyud pa dang / nga ngi ngaṛ ngu dang ngl̥ ngaṃ/ gha ghi ghṛ ghu ghl̥ ghaṃ dang / ga gi gu gli gaṃ kha khi khṛ khu khl̥ khaṃ/ ka ki kṛ dang 'khor lo rnams las skyes pa'i sa rdo rje ma la sogs pa mchu'i zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams spros/ shar sgo'i g.yon du mkha' lding gi steng gi pad ma dmar po'i lte ba dang 'dab mar rim bzhin 'khod/ ngaḥdang dbyug pa las gshin rje ljang gu g.yas dbyug pa ral gri/ g.yon lcags sgrog zhags pa 'dzin pa la/ gaṛ dang rtse gsum las skyes pa'i gshin rje ma sngon mo drag mo lta bus 'khyud pa dang / kā kī kṛ kū dang / kl̥̄ kaḥ khā khī khṝ khū khl̥̄ khaḥdang / gā gī gū gl̥̄ gaḥ ghra ghī ghṛ ghū gl̥̄ ghāḥ ngā ngī ngaṝ ngū ngal̥ dang / dbyug pa rnams las skyes pa'i kā rdo rje ma la sogs pa dbo'i zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams spros/ lho sgo'i g.yon du ma he'i steng gi padma dmar po'i lte ba dang 'dab mar rim bzhin 'khod/ de dag rnams kyang gtso bo rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la zhal phyogs pas rdo rje'i gdan gyis bzhugs pa la yum rnams padma'i gdan gyi 'khyud pa/ 'dab ma'i lha mo rnams rang rang gi gtso bo'i zhal mdog phyag mtshan 'dra bas gtso bo la zhal phyogs te rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /ya dang dbyug pa las dbyug sngon can nag po g.yas ral gri rdo rje/ g.yon phub sbrul 'dzin pa la/ lā dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i 'od zer can stobs po che lta bus 'khyud spros/ shar sgor phag nag po bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rtar 'khod/ ra dang mda' las 'dod pa'i rgyal po dmar po g.yas mda' lcags kyu/ g.yon gzhu zhags pa 'dzin pa la/ waḥdang tho ba las skyes pa'i tsundā mi g.yo ba lta bus 'khyud pa spros/

lho sgor rta dmar bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rtar 'khod/ wa dang gtun shing las mi g.yo ba dkar po g.yas tho ba/ mdung / g.yon padma me long 'dzin pa la rā dang mda' las skyes pa'i khro gnyer can 'dod rgyal lta bus 'khyud pa spros/ byang sgor seng ge dkar po bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rtar 'khod la dang be con las stobs po che ser po g.yas 'khor lo dbyug pa/ g.yon du rin chen 'dzin pa la/ yā dang ral gri las skyes pa rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dbyug sngon can lta bus 'khyud pa spros/ nub sgor glang po che ser po bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rtar 'khod/ haṃ dang rdo rje las gtsug tor can ljang gu g.yas dgra sta/ rtse gsum/ g.yon sbrul zhags/ kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa la/ haḥdang gri gug las skyes pa'i shin tu sngon mo gnod mdzes lta bus 'khyud pa spros/ steng du mkha' lding a nī la mdog lnga pa mig gsum pa lus rgyas pas drangs pa'i shing rta la 'khod/ ha dang dgra sta las gnod mdzes sngon po g.yas gri gug rdo rje/ g.yon thod pa dril bu 'dzin pa la/ hā dang dgra sta las skyes pa'i drag can ma gtsug tor lta bus 'khyud pa spros/ 'og tu rkang pa brgyad pa sha ra bhas drangs pa'i shing rtar 'khod/ de nas sku dkyil gyi phyi rol du rta babs bzhi'i ka ba brgyad kyi 'og gi g.yon g.yas so/ /hya hya dang rgyal mtshan las stobs rgyu dang padma nag po la nypa ṣa sha tha ka na dha tha ta dang gri gug las skyes pa'i ce spyang gdong ma dang / mkha' lding ma ser mos 'khyud pa spros/ shar du rlung gi dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ hra hra dang nor bu las nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar po la/ la wa ra ya ha ma bha ba ya pa dang gri gug las skyes pa'i stag gdong ma dang / 'ug gdong ma dang / dkar mos 'khyud pa spros/ lhor me'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ hwa hwā dang pad ma las rigs ldan dang mtha' yas dkar po la/ la wa ra ya kṣa ṇa ḍha ḍa ṭha ṭa dang gri gug las skyes pa'i phag gdong ma dang bya rgod gdong ma dmar mos 'khyud pa spros/

byang du chu'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ hla hlā dang rdo rje las 'jog po dang pad chen ser po la ka kha ga gha nga / ñdzha dza tsa tsha dang gri gug las skyes pa'i khyi gdong ma dang bya rog gdong ma nag mos 'khyud pa spros/ nub tu sa'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ hūm̐ dang rdo rje las rgyal ba ljang gu la haḥdang gri gug las skyes pa'i shin tu sngon mo sngon mos 'khyud pa spros te/ steng du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ kṣuṃ dang bum pa las rnam rgyal sngon po la/ ha dang gri gug las skyes pa'i rdo rje mig ma ljang gus 'khyud pa spros/ 'og tu ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ yab kyi g.yas bum pa rdo rje/ g.yon padma rin chen 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i gdan gyis bzhugs pa la/ yum gri gug thod pa 'dzin pas pad ma'i gdan gyis 'khyud pa'o/ /de nas me rlung gi dbus kyi dur khrod brgyad du/ ka kha ga gha nga dang gri gug las khyi gdong ma nag mo la/ hla dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i 'jog po ser pos 'khyud pa spros/ shar rtse mos 'bigs par bse'i steng du 'khor lo dmar po'i lte bar 'khod/ ñdzha dza tsha tsa dang gri gug las bya rog gdong ma nag mo la hlā dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i padma chen po ser pos 'khyud pa spros/ mer lhag ma za bar be ru ṇa'i steng du/ 'khor lo dkar po'i lte bar 'khod/ la wa ra ya kṣa dang gri gug las phag gdong ma dmar mo la/ hwa dang padma las skyes pa'i rigs ldan dkar pos 'khyud pa spros/ lhor ro bsregs par dom gyi steng du 'khor lo dmar po'i lte bar 'khod/ ṇa ḍha ḍa ṭha ṭa dang gri gug las bya rgod gdong ma dmar mo la/ hwā dang padma las skyes pa'i mtha' yas dkar pos 'khyud pa spros/ srin por mi bzad pa'i g.yul du khrung khrung gi steng du 'khor lo dkar po'i lte bar 'khod/ la wa ra ya ha dang gri gug las stag gdong ma dkar mo la/ ha ra dang nor bu las skyes pa'i nor rgyas dmar pos 'khyud pa spros/

byang rul pa dang bcas par 'bri'i steng du 'khor lo dmar po'i lte bar 'khod/ ma bha ba ya pa dang gri gug las 'ug gdong ma dkar mo la/ ha rā dang nor bu las byung ba'i dung skyong dmar mos 'khyud pa spros/ dbang ldan byis pa shi bar bshang gdong gi steng du 'khor lo dkar po'i lte bar 'khod/ snya ṣa sha tha ྈkadang gri gug las skyes pa'i ce spyang gdong ma ser mo la/ ha ya dang rgyal mtshan las skyes pa'i stobs rgyu nag pos 'khyud pa spros/ nub rnag gi drir seng ge'i steng du 'khor lo dmar po'i lte bar 'khod/ na dha da tha ta dang gri gug las mkha' lding gdong ma ser mo la/ ha yā dang rgyal mtshan las skyes pa'i padma nag pos 'khyud pa spros/ rlung sbrul gyis zos par mig sngon gyi steng du 'khor lo dkar po'i lte bar 'khod/ hūm̐ḥdang gri gug las sngon mo la/ hūm̐ dang bum pa las skyes pa'i rgyal ba ljang gus 'khyud pa spros/ steng du mkha' lding a nī las drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng du 'khod/ ha dang gri gug las rdo rje mig ma ljang gu la kṣuṃ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i rnam rgyal sngon pos 'khyud pa spros/ 'og tu rkang pa brgyad pa sha raṃ bhas drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng du 'khod/ yab yum rnams phyag mtshan sngar dang 'dra ba zlum po'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /de nas thugs dkyil 'dod yon la/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ tsa tsha dza dzha nyā dang dung chos me tog sngon po'i phreng ba las dri phreng ba nag mo phyag mtshan de nyid bsnams pa spros/ shar sgo'i g.yon g.yas su 'khod/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇā dang spos snod mar me las spros mar me ma dmar mo de nyid bsnams pa spros/ lho sgo'i g.yon g.yas su 'khod/ ka kha ga gha nga / ka kha ga gha ngā dang rnga pa ṭa ha gos las/ rol gar ma dkar mo de nyid bsnams pa spros/ byang du 'khod/ ta tha da dha na/ ta tha da dha nā dang dbu rgyan do shal las sgeg bzhad ma ser mo de bsnams pa spros/

nub sgo'i g.yon g.yas su 'khod/ snya pa ṣa sha ྈka/ snya ṣa sha tha ྈkadang rdo rje padma las glu 'dod ma ljang gu de nyid bsnams pa spros/ steng du 'khod/ pa pha ba bha ma/ pa pha ba bha mā dang bdud rtsi'i snod 'bras bu las bshos ma 'bras bu ma sngon mo de nyid bsnams pa spros/ 'og tu 'khod/ de nas gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi stegs bur/ tsa tsha dza dzña nya dang thong bshol/ gos/ gri gug bum pa/ chu gri las dbye/ gos/ 'phrug mchil 'dor/ skrod 'dod ma nag mo g.yas de nyid/ g.yon mi sha/ bshang lam/ rnag bad kan/ rkang gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa spros nas shar sgo'i lho nas me'i bar 'khod/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa dang dar dpyangs/ snod gcu gzer/ gos/ smug rtsi'i snod/ zas/ lus kyi dri ma/ gar/ skem 'dod ma dmar mo g.yas de nyid/ g.yon khrag lce/ shig srin bu/ rgyu mas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa spros/ lho sgo'i nub nas srin po'i bar 'khod/ pa pha ba bha ma dang / dung me long / rtse gsum/ rdo gru bzhi ku sha las rgyas/ rgyan/ stan/ rgyal srid/ 'jam par smra 'dod ma dkar mo g.yas de nyid/ g.yon khrag mig ba spu skra/ rus pas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa spros/ byang sgo'i shar nas dbang ldan gyi bar 'khod/ ta tha da dha na dang / smyu gu me tog phreng / khab/ nya'i rgya/ dar gyi bu srin bu las rengs/ dri/ mal stan gnye/ rkyal/ 'ching 'dod ma ser mo g.yas de nyid g.yon bshang ba/ sna/ chu ser/ zhag mkhris pas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa spros/ nub sgo'i byang nas rlung gi bar 'khod/ ṣa sha nypa ha dang gdugs/ ba lang rwa/ sha 'dzin/ rgyud mangs chung ba las/ reg bya/ yan lag bskyod/ lhag ma za nag rol mo 'dod ma ljang gu g.yas de nyid dang / g.yon mchin pa/ rna ba/ bshang lam gyi dri ma/ rna bas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa spros/ dbang ldan nas shar sgo'i bar 'khod/ khaḥgaḥghaḥྈkaḥdang / rgyud mangs/ khaṃ phor/ shing lham/ tog rtse las g.yul/ bshang gci zag 'gugs par/ rgyug 'dod ma sngo/

g.yas de nyid/ g.yon rtags/ sna'i dri ma/ glo ba/ snying gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa spros/ me nas lho sgo'i bar 'khod/ ya ra wa nga dang / spu gri/ 'phangaḥrma bya'i mjug sgro/ 'od ma'i dbyug pa las 'ching / lce'i dri ma tsod/ yan lag thams cad kyi dri byis khro dkar/ tshil bu gdung 'dod ljang / g.yas de nyid/ g.yon rtsa/ lce/ yan lag kun gyi dri/ tshil bus gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa spros/ rlung nas byang sgo'i bar 'khod/ saḥkaḥlaḥkṣaḥdang / mthil lham/ mda'/ thags/ chos 'byung las/ pags pa phur 'debs/ mchan khung dri sbrul 'ching / mig gi dri ma sems can bslu ser/ bha ga 'khrig 'dod ma sngo/ g.yas de nyid/ g.yon mi lpags/ mchan khung / mig gi dri ma/ bha gas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa spros/ srin po nas nub sgo'i bar 'khod/ de nas sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi stegs bur/ tsaṃ tshaṃ dzaṃ dzhaṃ nyaṃ/ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ/ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ/ paṃ phaṃ baṃ bhaṃ maṃ/ ṣaṃ shaṃ nypaṃ haṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ྈkaṃ/ yaṃ raṃ khaṃ ngaṃ/ saṃ kaṃ laṃ kṣaṃ dang sngar gyi phyag mtshan las mi 'dod ma phyir 'dod ma zhes kyang zer sum cu rtsa drug kha dog dang g.yas kyi phyag mtshan sngar dang 'dra ba dang / g.yon pa'i thod par sngar rim bzhin/ /khyi ra kumbhi ra 'gron bu/ /ne'u le rta dang ri dwags te/ /ku lī ra dang nya dang bse/ /ba lang bong bu rus sbal dung / /dom dang glang po phag chu srin/ /sbal pa stag 'bri ri bong dang / /go dha lug dang gzungs byi dur/ /byi ba ce spyang 'dab seng dang / /sram dang spre'u rtsangs spyang gi/ /byi la i shu ka dang ni/ /shā li dzā ta ka rnga mo'o/ /de rnams kyi nag mo rnams g.yon brkyang / dmar mo sa ga dkar mo padma'i gdan gyis bzhengs pa/ ser mo zlum po/ ljang gu sa ga sngon mo mnyam pa'i stabs can no/ /gzhan yang dur khrod kyi sa gzhi la skra dang ba spu rnam par dag pa'i 'byung po bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi dang /

dzi dzī dang / ral gri dang / dpag bsam shing las zla nyi nag po ral gri phub dang dpag bsam shing dang / ind+ra ni la 'dzin pa/ shar dang mer rlung gi dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ ḍ-il ḍ-il dang dbyug pa shakti las lhag pa dang mig dmar dmar po dbyug pa lcags sgrog dang / shagati padma 'dzin pa/ lho dang bden bral du me'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ bu bū dang zhags pa rtse gsum las pa sangs phur bu dkar po zhags pa sbrul zhags/ rtse gsum/ kha ṭwāṃ ga sbrul bcas 'dzin pa/ byang dang dbang ldan du chu'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ d-il d-ilā dang rdo rje be con las mjug rings spen pa ser po rdo rje dril bu rin chen ne'u le 'dzin pa/ nub dang rlung du sa'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ ga gā dang khab 'khor lo las sgra gcan dus me ljang sngo/ khab padma dang 'khor lo padma 'dzin pa/ steng 'og tu stong pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ gzhan yang brtan pa dang / ri byi dang / rgyu skar thams cad dang / khyim bcu gnyis dang cha bcu drug dang / phyogs bcu skyong ba dang / dga' byed dbang phyug dang / nag po chen po dang / dril bu'i rna ba can dang / bhṛdgi ṇa dang / zhing skyong thams cad dang / pho nya thams cad dang / 'phrog ma dang / grub pa thams cad dur khrod kyi mthar rlung gi dkyil 'khor steng du 'khod par bsam par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rang ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid kyi dus 'khor rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan pa chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng gi/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can rnams bkug dkyil 'khor de nyid du bcug pa la/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gis 'od kyis rigs lnga yab yum spyan drangs pa rang gi snying gar bcug byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur pa rang gi gsang gnas nas spros/ dbang bskur ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer gyis reg pa'i sems can de dag thams cad zhal gsum pa dang /

zhal dang sku'i kha dog sna tshogs pa'i lha shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid can mchog gi bde ba'i dga' bas gang bar gyur pa de rnams kyi phung po lnga dang / kṣa kṣi kṣ+r-i kṣu kṣl̥ las gshegs pa lnga/ khams lnga/ kṣā kṣī kṣ+ri kṣū kṣl̥ las gshegs ma lnga/ dbang po drug kṣa kṣe kṣ+ra kṣo kṣ+la kṣaṃ las sems dpa' drug yul drug kṣā kṣai kṣār kṣau kṣāl kṣāṃ la sems dpa' ma drug las dbang lnga/ kṣaha kṣ+ya kṣ+ra kṣawa kṣ+la las khro bo lnga/ bya ba lnga/ kṣaha kṣ+yā kṣ+rā kṣawa kṣ+la las khro mo lnga ste/ mtshan so gnyis kyi rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lhar gyur te rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par bsam mo/ /bzhi pa ni/ lha thams cad chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bor mos la/ oṃ su bi shuddha dharm+maḥhā tu swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ zhes brjod de nga rgyal gzung ngo / /gnyis pa las rgyal mchog la glus bskul te bzhengs pa/ mngal nas dkyil 'khor spro ba/ rdo rje bzhi yis rgyas gdab pa/ ye shes dgug cing ro mnyam pa/ sgo gsum gyi byin gyis brlab pa/ dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab/ lha'i rnam dag bsgom pa dang bdun gyi dang po ni/ rang gi dpral bar sku rdo rje oṃ/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje āḥ thugs kar thugs rdo rje hūm̐/ gtsug tor dang lte ba'i a wa dhū tī'i nang du ye shes rdo rje hoḥyig bkod de/ hoḥyig shes rab gtum mo'i me chags pa'i 'od zer gyis rdo rje can shes rab nus ma dang bcas pa ri bong 'dzin pa bzhin du zhu ba las tshad med pa bzhi'i rang bzhin gyi lha mo bzhi'i glus bskul bar bsam zhing / spyan ma bdag ni 'gro ba'i yum/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rgyu mthun gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /mā ma kī bdag sring mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rnam smin gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/

/gos dkar mo bdag bu mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yis skyes bur gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /sgrol ma bdag ni tsha mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dri bral gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /stong pa'i dkyil 'khor nyams myong nas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /'gro ba gdon pa'i bsam pa yis/ /'gro ba'i mgon pos spro bar mdzod/ /ces brjod pas/ stong pa nyid la bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das sad de/ 'gro ba mtha' dag sgyu ma lta bur gzigs nas/ zla ba zhu ba de las hūm̐ yig sngon po dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las dus kyi 'khor lo mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can dang / yum nus ma dang bcas pa'i sa bon phyag mtshan las sngar bzhin bskyed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa las/ /dkyil 'khor lnga'i rang bzhin gyi sangs rgyas nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams phung khams skye mched la sogs pa lha'i rnam par gnas pa rang gi lus la bcug byang sems su zhu ba las yum gyi padmar lha so so'i sa bon/ de las phyag mtshan/ de lha'i skur gyur pa las hūm̐ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i gtso bo mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rdor sems kyi cod pan la sogs pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bzhin spros/ gtso bo yab yum la zhugs/ shes pa nas phyir 'dod ma'i bar so so la zhugs zhes ngag tu brjod cing yid kyis bsam mo/ /gsum pa ni/ lha rnams kyi gtsug tor gyi 'khor los thig le ljang gu la a/ snying khar sgra gcan la i/ dpral bar zla ba la u/ lte bar dus me ser po la l̥/ mgrin par nyi ma la ṛ/ gsang bar ye shes la aṃ/ lte ba'i rlung la sar l̥/ snying kha'i la chur u/ mgrin pa'i la mer ri/ dpral ba'i la rlung du i/

gtsug tor du nam mkha'i rlung la nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor du a/ sems kyi bdag nyid dpral ba'i thig ler zla ba la oṃ/ mgrin pa'i nyi mar āḥ snying kha'i sgra gcan la hūm̐/ lte ba'i thig ler dus me la hoḥnor bur a bsams te/ sku gsung thugs ye shes kyis rgyas gdab pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha mtha' dag sku bzhi dang rdo rje'i bzhi bdag nyid kyi thabs shes su mos par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ rang gi snying khar zla nyi sgra gcan gyi steng gi hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar/ dzaḥyig las skyes pa'i rdo rje lcags kyu spros pas/ srid gsum gyi rnam pa can shin tu dwangs pa'i ye shes/ 'khor lo bkug a wa dhu ti'i sgo nas gtsug tor nas gsang bar zhugs/ byang sems su zhu ba yum gyi pad mar hūm̐ yig dang / de las rdo rjer gyur pa las skyes pa'i rdo rje shugs sngon po 'od zer 'phro ba 'jigs pa'i sku rab tu bzhad pa'i zhal bzhi pa/ mche ba phyed gtsigs pas sgra drag po sgrogs pa/ spyan bcu gnyis pa/ zhabs gnyis pa/ shes rab dang thabs las rab tu byung ba/ phyag nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ gtso bo bzhin du mtshon cha dang bcas pa/ phyag lhag ma sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas glang po che'i lpags pa'i gos 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ thod pa dang mgo phreng 'dzin pa/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i shing rta la gnas pa/ dbugs phyir dbyung ba dang lhan cig spros te/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang dzaḥzhes brjod pas/ des ye shes pa'i gtso bo'i lte bar rdo rje lcags kyus bsnun/ phyag rnams zhags pas bcings/ mtshon cha lhag ma rnams kyis 'jigs par byas te mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs nas rdo rje shugs rang gi snying gar thim par blta'o/ /de la lha mo bcu gnyis kyis mchod do/ /hūm̐ yig dang rdo rje'i phyag rgyas khro bo rmugs byed kyi lha so so la gzhug

baṃ dang zhags pa'i phyag rgyas khro bo rengs byed kyis dbyer med du bcing / hoḥdang dril bu'i phyag rgyas khro bo khengs byed kyis mnyes par byas/ hi dang dbyug pa'i phyag rgyas khro bo shin tu stobs kyis ro mnyam par bya ste/ de yang dbus su gtso bo yab yum la/ ye shes pa yab yum ro mnyam lha gzhan rnams kyi thugs kar ye shes pa yab yum ro mnyam pa nas sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi zla nyi ro mnyam pa'i bar ngag tu brjod cing bsam par bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar a las zla bar oṃ las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad par gyur pa'i sku rdo rje dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'khor lo/ padma/ rdo rje/ g.yon ral gri/ nor bu/ dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gsung rdo rje lta bus 'khyud par gyur pa spros/ de las de lta bu dpag med byung / nam mkha' gang ba'i sku rdo rjes 'dul ba'i sems can la chos bstan/ slar 'dus gcig tu gyur mdun du bzhugs pa la/ sku rdo rje 'dzin pas bdag cag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sku'i rigs kyis lha mo rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur dpral bar zla ba la 'khod par bsams la/ dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje'i mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /ces gsol ba btab pas ro mnyam ste lus sku rdo rjer gyur par bsam/ mgrin par ra las nyi mar āḥlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad par gyur pa'i gsung rdo rje dmar po dmar dkar nag pa'i zhal can phyag drug gi g.yas padma/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon nor bu/ dril bu/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ yum sku rdo rje lta bus 'khyud pa dang bcas pa spros/

de las de lta bu dpag med byung / nam mkha'i khams gang ba'i gsung rdo rjes 'dul ba'i sems can la chos bstan/ slar 'dus gcig tu gyur mdun du bzhugs pa la/ gsung rdo rje 'dzin pas bdag cag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes brjod pas/ gsung gi rigs kyi lha mo rnams kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur/ yang mgrin par nyi ma la 'khod par mos la/ dpal ldan gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin/ /sogs su 'don pa bsgyur nas gsol ba gdab pas ro mnyam ste ngag rdo rjer gyur/ snying gar thig le las sgra gcan sngon por hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur pa las/ thugs rdo rje nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje/ padma/ 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu/ nor bu/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ yum ser mo ser dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas nor bu/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon padma/ dril bu/ ral gri can dang bcas par gyur pa spros/ de las de lta bu dpag med byung / nam mkha'i khams gang ba'i thugs rdo rjes 'dul ba'i sems can la chos bstan/ slar 'dus gcig tu gyur mdun du bzhugs pa la/ thugs rdo rje 'dzin pas bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes brjod pas thugs kyi rigs kyi lha mo rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur/ snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la 'khod par mos la/ dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /sogs kyis gsol ba gdab pas/ ro mnyam ste sems thugs rdo rjer gyur par bsams la/ oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta kā ya wākka tsitta swa bhā wa ātma ko haṃ/ zhes pa de'i nga rgyal gzung zhing / khyad par du yum gyi lte bar hoḥ gsang bar swā/ gtsug tor la hā bsam mo/ /drug pa ni/ rang gi snying gar pad dmar dang zla ba'i steng gi rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis nam mkhar rgyal ba sras bcas dkyil 'khor gyis rnam par spyan drangs pa la/ lha mo bcu gnyis kyis mchod nas/

oṃ haṃ hāṃ/ hiṃ hīṃ/ hṛṃ hṝṃ/ huṃ hūṃ/ hl̥ṃ hl̥ṃ/ ā ī ṝ ū l̥̄/ badzra ḍā ki n+yau/ badzra a mṛ ta/ gha ṭai rā bh-i ṣiñtsantu māṃ swā hā/ zhes gsol ba btab pas yum lngas oṃ ā ī rī ū li pañtsa dhā tu bi sho dha ne swā hā/ chu dang / oṃ aṃ iṃ ṛṃ uṃ liṃ/ sarb+ba bud badzra mu ku ṭaṃ/ ma ma/ pañtsa buddha ātma kaṃ bandha yantu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis gsol ba btab pas rigs lngas/ oṃ a i ṛ u l̥ pañtsa ta thā ga ta pi ri shuddhe swā hās cod pan dang / oṃ a ā aṃ aḥ ha hā haṃ haḥphreṃ hoḥsarb+ba pā ra mi tā/ ma ma badzra paṭāṃ/ bandha yantu huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis gsol ba btab pas/ nus ma bcus/ oṃ a ā aṃ aḥ ha hā haṃ haḥ phreṃ ho ཿ da sha pā ra mi tā pa ri pu ra ṇi swā hā/ dar dpyangs dang / am̐ huṃ hoḥ bi dzñā na dzñā na swa bhā wa ka ru ṇa pra dzñā āmma ke/ badzra badzra ghaṇṭai/ sa bye ta ra ka ra yor/ ma ma badzra satwaḥ sa pra dzño da dā tus/ gsol ba btab pas/ gtso bo yab yum gyis/ oṃ huṃ hoḥ sūrya tsand+ra bi sho dha ka swā hās rdo rje dril bu'i dang / oṃ a ā e ai ar ār o au al āl aṃ aḥ sarb+ba bo dhi satwaḥ swa bhārya sarb+ba dā/ sarb+ba kā ma u pa bho gaṃ badzra bra taṃ ma mad danhu swā hā dang / sems dpa' sems mas/ o a ā e ai ar ār o au al āl aṃ aḥ bi ṣa yent+ri ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ brtul zhugs kyi dang / oṃ ha hā ya yā ra rā wa wā la lā/ sarb+ba kro dha rā dza/ sa bhāryā mai tri/ kā ru ṇa/ mu di ta/ ū pekṣa/ sarb+ba sa ma tā/ swa bhā bāṃ badzra pūrbaṃ ga maṃ nā ma me da dantu huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa dang / khro bo khro mos/ oṃ ha hā ya yā ra rā wa wā la lā/ tsa tur brahma bi hā ra bi shuddhe swā hās ming dang / o e waṃ padma badzra tsi hṇau/ pra dzño pā yau/ maṇḍal a dhi pa ti/ badzra su kha dzña nāṃ ga ma ma da da taṃ haṃ haḥhūm̐ phaṭa dang / rdor sems yab yum gyis/

oṃ haṃ kṣaḥdharma tsa kra pra brta ka swāhā/ rjes gnang gi dbang bskur bar bsam zhing / o sarb+ba ta thā ga ta/ sapta a bhi ṣe ka sapta bhū mi prāpto haṃ gis dbang bdun thob pa'i nga rgyal bzung / de bzhin du/ oṃ oṃ pradzñāo pa yau/ ka la sha a bhi ṣe kaṃ me da da taṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa dang / rang rigs kyi phyag rgya gtad pa'i nu mar reg pa'i g.yo ba'i bde bas dga' ba skyes par bsam zhing / oṃ oṃ badzra satwe na/ badzra ka la sha a bhi ṣe ke ṇa/ a bhi ṣikto badzra satwa pu tro tsa la bhu mi labdho haṃ gis bum dbang dang / oṃ āḥpradzñau pā yau/ gu hya a bhi ṣe kaṃ me da da taṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa dang / gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems myang zhing yum gyi gsang bar bltas pas/ g.yo ba'i bde ba lang tshor gyur pa'i mchog dga' dang / oṃ āḥbadzra satwe na/ gu hya a bhi ṣi ke ṇa/ a bhi ṣikto/ badzra satwa yu ba rā dzo na ba bhū mi labdho haṃ gis gsang dbang dang / oṃ hūm̐ pradzña pā yau/ badzra satwa/ bi shā mā ta rau/ pra dzñā dzñā na a bhi ṣe kaṃ me da da taṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa dang / phyag rgya'i lag pa bcangs pa las g.yo ba'i bde ba dar ma khyad dga' dang / rang rigs kyi phyag rgya dang sbyar bas gtsug tor nas nor bu'i bar khu ba 'dzag pa'i bde ba kun rdzob lhan skyes dang / oṃ hūm̐ badzra satwe na/ pra dzñā dzñā ne na/ a bhi ṣe ke ṇa/ a bhi ṣikto/ dwi tī ya badzra dha ro haṃ/ dharma me gha bhu mi labdho haṃ gis shes rab ye shes dang / oṃ hoḥ pra dzño pā ya ātma kaṃ badzra satwa mu dā dzña na/ a bh-i ṣe kaṃ me pra atstsha oṃ īḥhūm̐ hoḥ phaṭa dang nor bu'i rtse mo 'dzag pa'i ye shes kyi lhan skyes don dam gyi bzhi pa skyes par bsam zhing / oṃ hoḥdharm+ma dhā twakṣa ra/ tsa turtha a bhi ṣe ke ṇa/ a bhi ṣikto/ badzra satwe na ātma nā haṃ dwi tī ya dwā da sha bhū mi la maddho/ badzra sa twa ma hā arthaḥ pa ra mākṣa raḥ

trai lo kya bi dza yaḥ ka la tsakro bha ga wan e waṃ kāraḥs shes rab ye shes chen po thob pa'i nga rgyal gzung ngo / /de ltar dbang bcu gcig gis dbang bskur bas dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag pas/ gtso bo yab yum/ nus ma/ mi bskyod pa la rdor sems sngon po/ rdor sems la mi bskyod pa ljang gu gnyis ka sa gnon can/ rnam snang la mi bskyod pa/ snang mtha' la rnam snang / ring 'byung la 'od dpag med/ don grub la rin 'byung rnams gtsug tor dang chos gos mnabs pa/ byang chub mchog la sogs pa'i phyag rgya can gyis ral pa'i cod pan la dang / lha gzhan rnams la rin po che'i cod pan la ljang gu la mi bskyod pa/ sngon po la rdor sems/ nag po la don grub/ dmar po la rin 'byung / dkar po la snang mtha'/ ser po la snam snang gis rgyas gdab par bsgom mo/ /bdun pa ni/ bum pa rnams dang du ba la sogs brgyad po rnams kyis snying khar chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu 'gyur/ /rig ma rnams dang sangs rgyas nyid kyis mgo bor rtsibs bcu drug pa lhan cig skyes par rab tu grags/ /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs nyis 'gyur mi bdag rnams kyis mgrin par longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'khor lor 'gyur/ /'jigs ma la sogs nor ni gdengs can dag gis bsgyur ba rnams kyis lte bar sprul pa'i 'khor lor 'gyur/ /lag pa rkang pa'i tshigs la lha rnams kyis ni las kyi 'khor lo dgu bcu dus kyis bsnun pa ste/ /klu dang gtum mo mi yi bdag po rnams kyis sor mo'i tshigs kyi mtshams la bya ba zhes byar 'gyur/ /dus kyi dag pas dpal ldan rdo rje can 'gyur mi bdag lo dang zla ba la sogs dbye bas so/ /thugs kyi rnam pa nyi ma ma yin nyin zhag so so'i dbang gis sna tshogs yum ni rnam par dag /rlung gi dag pas du ba la sogs rang gi snying ga'i padmar rtsa yis 'khor lo la gnas rnams/ /nyon mongs rnams kyis drag po chung mar bcas pa khyab bdag zhabs kyi 'og tu bdud kyi tshogs kyis 'dud/

/dung dang gaṇḍī ma ṇi ljon pa zhes pa dag kyang de bzhin sku yi rdo rje la sogs kyis/ /bum pa brgyad ni bdud rtsi'i yan lag gis te rgyal dang rnam rgyal bum pa byang chub sems sogs kyis/ /'du byed don yod grub pa tshor ba dri med nor bu'i phyag dang 'du shes snang ba mtha' yas te/ /gzugs ni 'khor lo can no ri bong can dang stobs khrag bshang ba gcin pa rnam par dag pa'o/ /lha mo drug ni khams rnams kyis te yul dang yul can rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' phyag rgyar bcas/ /khro bo lnga ni stobs rnams kyis te nges par slar yang gzhan pa lnga ni dbang po gzhan rnams kyis/ /tsā muṇḍa sogs thun brgyad kyis te padma'i 'dab mar gnas rnams nyi ma'i dus sbyor chu tshod kyis/ /lha min lha sogs nyi ma'i zla bas pad ma'i 'dab mar gnas rnams chu tshod dbugs kyi grangs kyis so/ /gsang bar mi bdag nyis 'gyur chu tshod rnams kyis klu rnams dang ni gtum mo rnams kyang rnam par dag /de bzhin 'dod ma la sogs de dag rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis lus kyi bya bas rnam par dag /skra rnams kyis ni grub pa mtha' dag ba spu rnams kyis dur khrod sa gzhi la gnas 'byung po'i tshogs/ /de nyid rnams kyis gtso bo'i mtshon cha rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis khams kyis phyi yi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rjes nang gis phyag rgya rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du yang dag gnas pa'o/ /dpal ldan rdo rje can dang sna tshogs yum ni rnam gsum srid gnas 'gyur med ye shes dbye ba las/ /dpal ldan dag pa las ni chos skur 'gyur te chos las nges par longs spyod rdzogs sku bzang po'o/ /longs spyod las ni sprul pa'i sku ru 'gyur te rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sems can kun don byed pa po/ /bzhi pa'i gnas skabs shin tu gnyid log nges par slar yang gzhan dang lus kyi dbye bas sad pa ste/

/de ltar lus kyi rab tu dbye bas srog chags rnams kyi lus la yid rnam pa bzhi ru gnas/ sprul par yid ni longs spyod byed pa po ru rab tu 'gyur te lus dang ngag gi dbang pos so/ /longs spyod rdzogs la ma mthong sems dpar 'gyur te yon tan dbang gis chos kyi sku la gnyid kyang ngo / /dag pa la ni bde bar rab 'gyur 'dir ni mtshan dus su thig le grol ba gsum gyi mthar/ /de phyir de ni nyin mtshan dus su rnal 'byor pa yis bsgom par bya ste 'gyur med don du 'o/ /g.yon du srog ni rab tu rgyu bar 'gyur ba de bzhin du ni g.yas pa bskum pa gang yin pa/ /de ni g.yon brkyang stabs te mnyam pa'i stabs dang gzhan pa g.yas brkyang me dang nyi ma'i rgyu ba las/ /sa ga dang ni zlum po nyid dang mchog gi rol pa'i stabs dang padma dang ni rdo rje'i gdan/ /nam mkha' sogs la rab tu rgyu ba mnyam dang mi mnyam bgrod pa dag la srog rlung rnam pa lnga/ /zhes don dran bzhin pas brjod do/ /gsum pa thig le'i rnal 'byor ni/ yab yum gyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ gsang bar swa/ spyi bor hā/ shes rab kyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa las āḥlas padma 'dab brgyad hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/ rang gi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa āḥlas skyes pa'i padma mtshan par bsgoms nas snyoms par zhugs par bsam zhing / srog thur kha sbyar bas lte ba'i hoḥ yig gi me 'bar bas g.yon g.yas kyi rlung dbu mar zhugs/ g.yon g.yas su rgyu ba 'gags pas dbang po yul la 'jug pa med par gzugs sems ro gcig tu 'dres/ me de a wa dhū ti nas song / spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas haṃ zhu thig le'i gzugs kyis dpral ba nas mgrin par 'dzag pa dga' ba/ de nas snying kar mchog dga'/ de nas lte bar khyad par gyi dga' ba/ de nas gsang bar 'dzag pa'i bde ba la dmigs pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba bsgom pa'o/

/bzhi pa phra mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ de nas byang sems gyen du gshegs te nor bu'i rtse nas lte bar byon pa rgyu mthun/ snying kar rnam smin/ mgrin par skyes bu byed pa/ dpral bar dri ma med pa'i tshul gyis byon pa las pra phab pa lta bu'i tshul gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo spros/ khams gsum gyi sems can gyi sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du gyur par dmigs nas/ oṃ sarb+ba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko haṃ/ zhes pas rjes su chags pa'i nga rgyal gsung ngo / /gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga la/ sngags kyi bzlas pa/ mchod cing bstod pa/ gshegs su gsol ba/ smon lam/ bkra shis/ bdag nyid bsrung ba/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba dang drug las/ dang po ni/ lha rnams kyi thugs kar g.yas kyi phyag mtshan dang po'i lte bar sa bon la rang rang gi sngags bkod/ las dang rjes su mthun pa'i phreng ba byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaṃ kṣa ma na wa ra ma na ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po dang / oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hṛṃ hruṃ hral̥ṃ hrāḥswā hā/ zhes pas nye snying dang / 'og gi mchod sngags la thog mar oṃ dang mthar hūm̐ phaṭa/ na maḥ'i tshab tu sbyar nas zlos pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum gyi dang po ni/ phyi mchod de mdun du bshams pa'i mchod rdzas oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaṃ kṣa hra phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ mchod rdzas dang lha mo rnams sngar bzhin bskyed la/ so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs nas/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /zhes pad kor sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod yon bsang gtor dang / tsa sde thung ngu las skyes pa'i/ /dri ma dri yi snod bsnams pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pa'i tshogs spros te/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod par bgyi/ /zhes dang / rkang pa phyi ma gnyis 'dra bar sbyar la/

tsa sde ring po las skyes pa'i/ /phreng ba rin chen phreng 'dzin ma nam mkha' 'dre/ ṭa sde thung ngu las skyes pa'i/ /spos ma rdo rje'i spos bsnams ma/ /ṭa sde ring po las skyes pa'i/ /sgron ma sgron ma'i snod bsnams pa/ /pa sde thung ngu las skyes pa'i/ /bshos ma bdud rtsi'i snod bsnams pa/ /nam mkha'/ dkyil 'khor/ pa sde ring po las skyes pa'i/ /lha mo 'bras bu'i tshogs bsnams ma/ ta sde thung ngu las skyes pa'i/ /sgeg mo gos rgyan bsnams pa ni/ /ta sde ring po las skyes pa'i/ /bzhad ma rin chen do shal bsnams/ ka sde thung ngu las skyes pa'i/ /pa ṭa ha rnams sil snyan ma/ /ka sde ring po las skyes pa'i/ /gar ma sna tshogs gos 'dzin ma/ /sa sde thung ngu las skyes pa'i/ /glu ma rdo rje'i glu len ma/ /sa sde ring po las skyes pa'i/ /'dod ma rdo rje'i chu skyes 'dzin/ /nam mkha' khyab pa'i tshogs spros te/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod par bgyi/ /zhes pa sngar gyi sngags so so dang spel ba brjod pa dang / mthar rol mos mchod do/ /gnyis pa nang mchod ni/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis lan gsum dkrugs/ dbus nas blangs te/ maṇḍal la chos 'byung gru gsum gyi dbus su thig le ltar zlum por bskor byas la/ der ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dwangs shing gzugs brnyan dang mtshungs pa bsgom ste phud gtor zhing / oṃ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la na maḥde bzhin du mgor oṃ dang mthar na maḥsbyar la/ dbang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo la/ zla bzang / lha dbang / gzi brjid can/ zla bas byin/ lha yi dbang phyug /sna tshogs gzugs/ lha'i dbang ldan/

'jam dbyangs grags pa/ padma dkar po/ 'jam dbyangs sprul pa/ tsi lu ā tsārya/ paṇḍi ā tsārya dus zhabs pa che ba/ dus zhabs pa gnyis pa/ mañdzū kī ra ti/ sa manta shrī/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge/ rwa 'bum seng / rje btsun rgwa lo/ bla ma shes seng / bla ma dpal ldan pa/ bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ zhes rwa lugs dang / pad dkar yan 'dra ba la/ bzang po/ rnam rgyal bshes gnyen bzang po/ phyag dmar/ khyab 'jug sbas pa/ nyi ma grags/ shin tu bzang / rgya mtsho rnam rgyal/ rgyal dka'/ nyi ma grags/ shin tu bzang / rgya mtsho rnam rgyal/ rgyal dka'/ nyi ma/ sna tshogs gzugs/ zla 'od/ mtha' yas/ sa skyong / dpal skyong / dus zhabs pa che ba/ chung ba/ kha che zla mgon/ sgom pa dkon mchog bsrungs/ sgro ston gnas brtsegs/ grub thob yu mo mi bskyod rdo rje/ dharme shwa ra/ grub thob nam mkha' 'od/ grub thob se mo che/ chos rje 'jam gsar/ chos sku 'od zer/ kun spangs chos rje/ byang sems rgyal ye/ kun mkhyen 'phags pa/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa la na maḥ oṃ buddhā ya na maḥ dharmā ya na maḥ saṃ ghā ya na maḥ badzra sa twā ya/ pra dzñā pā ra mi tā yai/ swa bhā bi ka kā yā ya/ dharmā kā yā ya/ saṃ bho ga kā yā ya/ nirmāṇa kā yā ya/ dzñān badzrā ya/ tsitta badzrā ya/ wā ka badzrā ya/ kā ya badzrā ya/ tsa turbi mokṣe bhyo/ tsa tur brahma bi hā re bhyo/ sasta triṃ shad bo dhi pākṣi ka dharmai bhyo/ tsa turbī ti sa ha sra dharm+ma skandhe bhyo/ sarb+ba dharm+ma de sha ke bhyo/ ratna tra yā ya/ shākya mu na ye/ kā la tsakrā ya/ dā na pā ra mi tā yai/ shī la pā ra mi tā yai/ kṣanti pā ra mi tā yai/ bīrya ra mi tā yai/ dhya na pā ra mi tā yai/ pradzñā pā ra mi tā yai/ u pā ya pā ra mi tā yai/ pra ṇi dhā na pā ra mi tā yai/ ba la pā ra mi tā yai/ dzñā na pā ra mi tā yai/ dza ya gha ṭe bhyo/ bi dza ya gha ṭe bhyo/ sarba tsi hno bhyo/

sarb+ba mu dre bhyo/ tsinta ma lnga ye/ dharm+ma gaṇḍ+yai/ dharm+ma shaṃ khā ya/ kalpa brikṣā ya/ a kṣo bhya ya/ a mo gha siddha ye/ ratna saṃ bhā bā ya/ ya mi tā bhā ya/ bai ro tsa nā ya/ lo tsa nā yai/ mā ma kyai/ phaṇḍa rā yai/ tā rā yai/ badzra dhā twi shwa ryai/ badzra pā ṇa yai/ kha gadbhā ya/ kṣi ti garbhā ya/ lo ke shwa rā ya/ sarb+ba na bi ri ṇa biskambi ne/ sa manta bha dra ya/ ghāndha badzra yai/ rū pa badzra yai/ ra sa badzrā yai/ sparba badzrā yai/ shabha badzrā yai/ dharm+mā dhā tu badzrā yai/ uṣṇī ṣā ya/ bighnan ta kā ya/ pra dzñānta kā ya/ pad mwanta kā ya/ ya mānta kā ya/ stambhi n+yai/ mā ni n+yai/ sto bhi n+yai/ a te bārya yai/ a ti nī lā yai/ sarb+ba dhā ri ṇī bhyo/ ṣa ḍaṃ gā ya na maḥzhes pas thugs dkyil dang / badzra tsartsatsi ka yai/ badzra wā rā hyai/ badzra ma he shwa ryai/ badzrandhai/ badzra brahma ṣyai/ badzra ma hā lakṣ+mai/ badzra kau māryai/ badzra beṣṇa bhyai/ iṣṭa aṣṭa ke na tsa tuḥ ṣaṣṭhi badzra yo gi nī bhyo/ ṣaṭatiṃ shad itstsha bhyo/ zhes pas gsung gi dkyil 'khor dang / badzra beṣṇa be/ badzra nai ri tya ya/ badzra agnaye/ badzro ddha ye/ badzre ndā ya/ badzre shwa rā ya/ badzra brahma ṇe/ badzra bi nā ya kā ya/ badzra kā rti ka yā ya/ badzra badzra mā ya/ badzra yakṣe bhyo/ bā ru ṇyai/ bā ya be/ yā mi ṇyai/ yakṣi ṇyai/ ma hā ba lā ye/ a tsa lā ya/ ṭakki rā dzā ya/ nī la daṇḍā ya/ sumabba rā dzā ya/ rau drā kṣ+yai/ badzra shriṃ kha lā yai/ tsundā ye/ bhri ku ṭyai/ mā ri tsyai/ pra tye ka mā sa bhe de na ṣaṣṭhi utta ra tri sha ta badzrā ti thi de wī bhyo/ ṣaṭatiṃ shatpa tī tstsha bhyo/ badzra dza yā ya/ badzra karko ṭa kā ya/ badzra bā su ka ye/ badzra a nantā ya/ badzra takṣa ya/ badzra ma hā padma ya/ badzra ku li kā ya/ badzriṃ shaṃ kha pā la ya/ badzra padmā ya/ badzra bi dza yā ya/ zhes pas sku'i dkyil 'khor dang / shwā nā syā yaṃ/ sū ka rā sya yai/ byā ghā sya yai/ dzaṃ bu kā syā yai/ ga ru ḍa sya yai/

u lu kā sya yai/ ghri dhā sya yai/ kā kā sya yai/ sarb+ba ghu to bhyo/ zhes pas dur khrod la dang / badzra tsand+ra ya/ badzra sūryā ya/ badzra madga lā ya/ badzra bu dhā ya/ badzra bri haspa te yai/ badzra shu krā yai/ badzra sha nashtsai ra ya/ badzra sha ke ta be/ badzra ra ha be/ badzra kā la agab ye/ badzra dhra be/ badzra a gsatya/ sarb+ba nakṣa tre bhyo/ dwā da sha rā si bhyo/ ṣo ḍa sha ka lā bhyo/ dasha dikapā le bhyo/ badzra nandi ke shwa rā ya/ badzra ma hā kā lā ya/ badzra ghaṇḍa ya/ badzra bhriṃ gi ṇā ya/ sarb+ba kṣe tra pā le bhyo/ sarb+ba du tī bhyo/ hā ri tyai/ sarb+ba siddhi bhyo/ dharm+ma tsakrā ya/ bha dra gha ṭā ya/ badzra dundu bhyai/ bo dhi bṛkṣa ya/ oṃ gu ru buddha bo dhi sa twe bhyo na mo na maḥ zhes pas phyi rol 'jig rten pa'i lha la dbul lo/ /de nas lus kyi lha mchod pa'i phyir lce rtse smin mtshams spyi gtsug tu gtor la mnyes par bsam/ de bzhin du chos skyong gzhi bdag sogs dang / sems can thams cad dus 'khor gyi lha tshogs su dmigs pa la 'bul lo/ /gsum pa bstod pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong nyid snying po khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas snang ba khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas gsung ba khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /dngos med las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud/ /nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas gar mdzad khyod la 'dud/ /thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/

/ces pas bstod nas yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ nongs pa bzod par gsol nas mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub blang ngo / /gsum pa ni/ /rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ rdo rje bcings la/ sangs rgyas yab yum bcas pa sras bcas g.yog 'khor dang / /grogs bcas gnyen rnams dag gi bskor ba'i tshogs pa ni/ /lha dang lha mo dag gis mnyes par byed rnams dang / /mchog gi rdo rje sems dpa' dag ni gshegs su gsol/ /zhes pas dbugs nang du 'jug pa dang bstun te/ gtsug tor du rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar bde chen 'khor lo/ /snying khar rtse mo dgu pa'i lte bar nu ma/ dpral bar rtse mo bcu bdun pa'i lte bar rigs lnga yum bzhi/ mgrin par rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lte bar sems dpa' sems ma dang / thugs kyi khro bo bzhi/ lte bar rtse mo drug cu rtsa lnga pa'i lte bar gsung gi lha/ gsang bar rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lte bar sku'i khro bo yab yum/ las kyi 'khor lo rtse mo sum cu rtsa gcig pa'i lte bar tshes kyi lha/ bya ba'i 'khor lo rtse mo bdun pa'i lte bar klu dang rab gtum ma rnams gshegs su gsol te/ lus kyi khams so so la 'khod/ lag pa'i rgyab bstan te se gol gyis 'jig rten pa rnams rang rang gnas su gshegs par bsam mo/ /bzhi pa ni/ de nas/ ji ltar nyi ma dang bcas thub pa'i rigs ni shes rab ye shes thob pa 'di las byung gyur pa/ /rnam gsum srid pa la gnas sems can rnams ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i drin las de ltar 'gyur bar shog /skyes bu gang dag bdud kyi grogs kyis rtag tu mi bden mun par song zhing lam nyams pa/ /de dag rnams kyis lam 'di thob nas rdo rje nor bu'i khyim dang ring min 'ong gyur cig /dus 'khor gsang ba legs rtogs dam tshig yongs ldan zhing / /'di ston bla ma'i rjes 'brangs rdo rje spun la sogs/ /phan tshun legs par smra zhing 'khon du mi 'dzin dang /

/dam tshig rdo rjes gleng slong dal gyis gnas par shog /ma rungs dam bral ngan pa'i las byed cing / /rnal 'byor ched du mi gnyer skye bo gang / /de dag mi 'grogs de yis mi mthong dang / /rang sdug bla ma rdo rje mchod par shog /rtsod ldan dus su gsang chen ston byed dang / /mu stegs skye bo ngan pa'i lta 'joms shing / /gang de'i lta ba dpyis nas 'don byed pa'i/ /de dag 'dul ba'i ded dpon de byed shog /ces pa'i dge rtsa bsngos la/ gang dag steng na bdud kyi phyogs gnas lha ma yin rnams mchog tu 'jigs byed byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /mi yi 'jig rten dag na phyogs dang phyogs bral du gnas khro bo'i rgyal po btsun mor bcas pa rnams/ /gang dag sa 'og dag na gdengs can dbang pos gdon tshogs mi dge thams cad dus su 'ching byed pa/ /de dag thams cad nyin zhag so so'i dus su mi shes 'jig rten kun nas skyong bar byed gyur cig /ces pa'i shis pa brjod do/ /lnga pa ni/ rang gi mgo bor hriṃ/ mgrin par hrīṃ/ snying khar hruṃ/ lte bar hl̥ṃ/ gsang bar hrāḥ gtsug tor du hrām̐ gis mtshan par bsgoms la/ thal mo sbyar ba'i mthe bos gnas de dag tu reg cing / oṃ hrāṃ shi khā yai wa ṣa ṭa/ oṃ hṝṃ la lā ṭa ye hūm̐/ oṃ hṝṃ gri bā ya bau ṣaṭa/ oṃ hruṃ hri dā yā ya swā hā/ oṃ hl̥̄ṃ nā bhyai na maḥ.oṃ hrāḥgu hyā ya phaṭa/ ces brjod pa dang / mgo bor ū/ snying khar ī/ gtsug tor du ā/ thabs kyi dang / lte bar l̥̄/ mgrin par rī/ gsang bar aḥshes rab kyi sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon gyis bsrungs la/ lha'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam la 'jug go /drug pa ni/ srung 'khor ltar/ srung ma drug cu dang / zhing skyong / gzhi bdag rnams la gtor ma thun mtshams gsum du sbyin zhing / kha zas rnams gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ phud oṃ āḥhūm̐ sngags nas/ bla ma dang /
