'dod lha dang / gtor ma la dbul lo/ de nas oṃ ha rī tī piṇḍa ke pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes 'phrog ma la chang bu gnyis dang / oṃ du tī kī a grā grā saṃ pra tītstsha swā hās pho nya mo la chang bu zas kyi phud la byin nas bza' ba'i mthar ji srid par sa la gzhag ste/ lha'i rnal 'byor gyis zas zos pa'i lhag ma/ oṃ kha khā khā hi khā hi u tstshiṣṭa ba liṃ bhakṣa bhakṣa ka swā hā/ zhes 'byung po rnams la sbyin te/ bsod nams 'di yis rnam gsum srid pa la gnas sems can rnams ni bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par shog /ces pas dge ba bsngo zhing / nyal ba'i tshe/ 'dod pa'i phyogs su rnal 'byor gyis gnyid log la/ ldang ba'i tshe/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis cang te'u'i sgras gnyid las bslang bar bsam zhing / mal nas langs te/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams la phyag byas nas/ dbang bskur ltar khrus byas te/ dge ba'i bya bas dus 'da' bar bya'o/ /gang gis tshogs 'khor dang 'brel ba na/ bstod pa'i rjes su gtor ma dang / kha zas kyi rnal 'byor byas te/ mjug tu bsngo ba nas bsrung ba'i bar bya zhing / spro na/ mdun du maṇḍal byas nas gshegs gsol gyi mthar mdun bskyed la mchod bstod byas nas gtor ma dbul ba mar bcad bya'o/ /tshul de lta bus rgyun du gnas na 'og min gyi mthar thug pa'i 'jig rten gyi dngos grub mtha' dag dngos su 'grub cing / brgyud nas mchog gi dngos grub kyang 'grub par 'gyur ba nyid do/ /rgyud 'grel bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs pa/ /sgom pa'i rim pa bkod la nongs pa gang / /bla ma lhag pa'i lha yis bzod par mdzod/ /legs pa gang des gzur gnas don gnyer ba'i/ /skye bo kun gyi blo gros brgyan gyur zhing / /dge bas 'gro kun stong nyid snying rje'i bdag /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo nyid gyur cig

/dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan bla mas legs par gsal bar mdzad pa'i rjes su mthun par/ a wa dhū tī pa'i btsun pa bsod nams kyis/ bla ma ye shes dbang phyug ces bya ba/ mdo khams shar phyogs kyi sa'i char sku 'khrungs pas 'phral 'phral du bskul ba'i ngor legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rgyal mtshan bzang pos bgyis te/ sna tshogs dbyig gi lo mgo'i zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad la yongs su rdzogs par bsgrubs pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /khro bo reg tshig gi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa bzhugs so// reg tshig gi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang / yi ge brgya pa'i sngags bzlas sgom sngon du song nas/ skad cig gis rang khro bor bskyed pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams spyan drangs pa la/ mchod pa lngas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs kyi yan lag bdun pa bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ shū n+ya tās stong par bsgom/ de nas bhrūm̐ las me'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su/ padma dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dgu'i dbus ma la hūm̐ las 'od 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ gdon bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ khro bo reg tshig sku mdog nag po/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas 'jigs byed nag po dang / g.yon bskum pas dus mtshan dmar mo mnan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i steng na me'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ g.yon pas tri shū la'i steng na me'i 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa bsnams pa/ phyogs brgyad du hūm̐ brgyad las khro mo brgyad yab dang 'dra ba bskyed/ thams cad kyang ba spu kun nas me dpung 'phro ba/

dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra ser po gyen du 'bar ba/ gzugs rags pa/ spyan gsum bgrad pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ gad mo sgrogs pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sbrul dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing / stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can du bsams pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ bsam/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ mchod pas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par bstim/ dbang gi lha spyan drangs la mchod pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / a bhi ṣektas dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang lhag ma lud pas/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ 'khor lo la phog pas/ g.yon du myur du 'khor/ dgra bgegs rbod gtong la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bzlog de'i tshe khro bo thams cad zhal phyir bstan/ sngags zlos par bsam ste/ om̐ bha ya nā sa ni/ trā sa ni/ sarb+ba mā ra pra tyaṃ gi ra/ bi nā sa ni/ ya ge tsitta duṣṭan satwa da ma ka ma ma bi ru pa kaṃ ku ru bhanti ta ni sarb+ba ni/ pra ti ka ri ṇi pa ta tu hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bzlas so/ /de'ang snying ga'i hūm̐ gi steng du bla ma/ g.yas su pha/ g.yon du ma/ mdun du spun zla/ rgyab tu 'khor/ 'og tu nor rdzas bsgoms pas de dag bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas mchod pa a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs nas/ rang rang gi sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ badzra kro dha rā dza sa pa ri bā ra zhes kun la sbyar la arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma/ de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma/ ārya de ba/ ratna saṃ gī tī/

buddha saṃ gī tī/ padma saṃ gī tī/ ba raṃ lo tsā ba/ dge bshes dbus pa/ mnga' ris pa skyi ston/ jo bo stag bzang / nag tsho rig 'dzin bud sgang pa/ nag tsho shes rab rgyal mtshan/ dar ma rgyal mtshan/ gron gyi slob dpon 'brom ston/ dgon 'og pa/ bla ma bsod dbang la sogs pa dang / yi dam rnams la 'bul/ de nas rang gi lce rtse/ dpral ba/ snying ga rnams su chang gis reg pas lus kyi lha mchod/ chos skyong mkha' 'gro gnas khyad par can gyi srung ma gzhi bdag rnams mchod de/ rtog med spros bral stong nyid snying rje'i klong / /ye shes thugs kyi 'od zer spro bsdu yis/ /log 'dren ngan sel thugs kyi klong du sbyong / /mnyam nyid tha dad med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /'jigs pa'i skur ston 'bar ba'i gzi brjid can/ /sdigs par byed pa'i mtshon cha phyag na bsnams/ /gdug pa thabs kyis 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos nyid mi 'gyur sku mdog mun ltar nag /sgrib gnyis bsreg mdzad gzi brjid me ltar 'bar/ /dug lnga dbyings sgrol stag dang sbrul gyis brgyan/ /pha rol phyin drug rgyun du 'chang la 'dud/ /ha ha he he 'jigs pa'i bzhad sgra sgrog /hūm̐ phaṭa sgra yis dgra bgegs skrag mdzad cing / /ljags kyi sbu gus dgra bgegs don snying dub/ /gdug pa zhal du gsol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes rab rdzogs stong nyid snying rje 'chang / /mtshan ma'i brtag pas gzhig cing gzhom du med/ /dngos rnams rab 'joms shes rab 'khor lo 'chang / /gcod byed mtshon cha bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsum lhun grub rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga /sdang ba'i sems ldan lus ngag yid gsum sgrol/ /phrin las sgrib med tshad med 'khor lo 'chang / /dgra bgegs dbyings su sgrol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /so so'i thugs las sprul pa'i khro mo brgyad/ /sde brgyad 'dul ba'i gnyen por phyogs mtshams spros/

/gtso bo bsrung phyir zhal rnams phyir bltas te/ /sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod do/ /de nas gtor ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gyad gsum gyi sgyed bu'i steng du/ oṃ las thod pa'i nang ni dbus su ya/ shar du raṃ/ lhor laṃ/ nub tu khaṃ/ byang du aṃ las dgra bgegs kyi mkhris pa/ khrag klad pa/ sha/ rus pa'i steng du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros dgra bgegs kyi snying khrag badzra aṃ gu sha dzaḥzhes pas bkug nas yig 'bru la thim pas 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsir bsam/ oṃ bha ya na badzra kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros lha dgu dang pho nya srin po rākṣa sa mthu bo che dang bcas pa spyan drangs te/ sku gsung thugs byin gyi brlabs ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / rtsa sngags la kro dha ba liṃta/ kha kha khā ti khā hi/ thum bha thumbha kha khā hi/ ma hā khā hi/ ma hā māṃ sa kha khā hi/ zhe sdang sha yi mchod pa bzhes/ /gti mug rus pa'i mchod pa zhes/ /'dod chags khrag gi mchod pa zhes/ /nga rgyal klad pa'i mchod pa zhes/ /phrag tog mkhris pa'i mchod pa bzhes/ /ma ra tsitta srog thung kha khā hi/ bdun naṃ gsum brjod la dbul/ hūm̐ khro rgyal reg tshig stobs po che/ /mun nag lta bu'i sku 'dzin zhing / /phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs me lce 'bar/ /mgon du gyur la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dgra bgegs rnams kyi sha rus khrag /klad mkhris nyon mongs dug lnga rnams/ /ye shes lnga ru byin rlabs pa'i/ /gtor ma rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /bar du gcod pa thams cad dang / /bsam ngan gdug rtsub ma lus pa/ /khyod kyi thugs rje'i mthu stobs dang / /phrin las thogs pa med pa yis/

/nges par zhi nas 'gro kun la/ /byams pa'i sems su gnas par mdzod/ /gang zhig zhi bar ma gyur na/ /de yi mthu nus dpung tshogs kun/ /mngon spyod las kyis tshar bcad de/ /gtan nas brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /khro bo'i bka' nyan mthu bo che/ /lha chen nag po tshangs pa'i sras/ /dbyug pa chen po khros pa'i sku/ /srin po rakṣa mthu bo che/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs chen mi la chibs/ /sku mdog smug nag gcer bu la/ /lcags kyi ral pa sha ra ra/ /dpral bar khrag gi mig dgu la/ /khrag gi mchi ma nyi li li/ /g.yas gnyis ro dbyug lcags ber bsnams/ /dbyug pas byobs la ber kas brdungs/ /g.yon gnyis lcags kyu zhags pa bsnams/ /lcags kyus khug la zhags pas bcings/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i snying mgo chod/ /rakṣa 'bar ba'i g.yas g.yon na/ /lcags kyi mon pa nag po gnyis/ /lcags kyi ral pa gtsug na mdzes/ /lag na lcags kyi tho skam thogs/ /skam pas bzung la tho bas brdungs/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /ces phrin las bcol/ tshogs la rol/ lhag ma btang / dge ba bsngos la/ sngar gyi bskul gyi rjes su/ e ka du na bzlog ma hā du na bzlog sa ka du na bzlog za ka du na bzlog tsa tur snying la bzlog dam tshig la sa ma ya/ srog bdag snying la sa ma ya/ gnod byed snying la bhyo bhyo/ ma ma ru tra u nan gnod byed mā ra ya/ gnod byed nā sha ya/ gnod byed stam bha ya bhyo/ bka' bzlog nag po'i tshogs/ ye shes bya khyung gi tshogs/ gdug pa chu srin gyi/ dpal mo rgyun phreng gi/ lha chen brgyad kyi/ klu chen brgyad kyi/ mi nag rta nag gi/ mi ser rta ser gyi tshogs bzlog cig rang gshed rang la phob cig rang gi srung ma rang la bza' ru chug cig swā hā zhes brjod la gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang / bzod par gsol la gshegs su gsol/ /dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o/ /khro bo reg tshig gi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/
